title: 小学至初一英语语法详解·扩充版

sections.title: 01 句子有骨架：谁，怎么样，做什么

blocks.text: 先认出一句话在谈谁，再找出它说这个人或事物“是什么、怎么样、做什么”。主语是句子谈论的对象；谓语里的动词说明动作或状态。
规则

rows: Lily is a student. 莉莉是学生。
I like music. 我喜欢音乐。
I read books at home after dinner.

blocks.text: 例句
The little boy / plays / football. 小男孩踢足球。先找boy，再找plays。
My two friends / are / happy. 我的两个朋友很开心。这里用are连接状态。
We / have / a new teacher. 我们有一位新老师。have已经是谓语动词。
容易混淆
He is happy. 正确；He plays football. 正确。不能写 He happy.，也不能把“他踢球”写成He is play football.。但 He is playing football. 是正确的进行时，第10课会学。

questions.prompt: 找出主语和动词：My father cooks dinner.
questions.reference: 主语My father；动词cooks；dinner是动作涉及的对象。

questions.prompt: 连词成句：like / we / English
questions.reference: We like English. 主语在前，谓语动词随后。

questions.prompt: 补全：The classroom ___ clean.
questions.reference: is。这里用be连接主语和形容词clean。

sections.title: 01.1 词类：同一个词在句子里做什么

blocks.text: 词类说明一个词通常怎样使用。先判断词在当前句子里的作用，再决定它应该放在哪里、是否需要变化。同一个词可以有不止一种词性。
规则详解
名词给人、物、地点或想法命名；代词代替已知的人或物。teacher、water、school是名词，he、them、mine是代词。
动词表示动作或状态；形容词说明人或物的性质；副词常修饰动作、形容词或整个句子。介词连接名词性成分，表示时间、位置等关系；连词连接词、短语或句子。
判断词类要看位置和意思，不能只看中文翻译。book可以表示“书”，也可以表示“预订”；clean可以表示“干净的”，也可以表示“打扫”。
例句与解析
1. I read a book every day. 我每天读一本书。book是read的宾语，是名词。
2. We want to book a room. 我们想预订一间房。book表示动作，是动词。
3. The room is clean. 房间很干净。clean说明room的状态，是形容词。
4. We clean the room on Fridays. 我们周五打扫房间。clean是谓语动词。
5. The fast train is coming. 快车来了。fast修饰名词train。
6. The train moves fast. 火车开得快。fast说明moves这个动作的方式。
对比辨析
不能因为fast没有-ly就判定它不能作副词；也不能因为friendly以-ly结尾就把它放到所有动词后。She is friendly.中的friendly表示“友好的”，是形容词。

questions.prompt: 判断clean的词性：Please clean the desk.
questions.reference: 动词。这里要求听话的人打扫桌子。

questions.prompt: 判断clean的词性：The desk is clean.
questions.reference: 形容词。这里描述桌子的状态。

questions.prompt: 选词：She speaks English (good / well).
questions.reference: well。它修饰speaks，表示说得怎样。

questions.prompt: 找出介词：The cat is under the chair.
questions.reference: under。后面接the chair，表示位置关系。

sections.title: 01.2 句子成分：主语、谓语、宾语与表语

blocks.text: 词类是词的类别；句子成分是词或短语在这一句中的任务。一个名词短语可以作主语，也可以作宾语。先找句子里发生的动作或存在的状态，再确定有关的人和物。
规则详解
主语是句子主要谈论的对象。谓语说明主语做什么或处于什么状态，通常包含一个有时态的动词或动词组合。宾语是动作涉及的对象。
表语放在be等系动词后，说明主语的身份、性质或状态。定语修饰名词；状语补充时间、地点、方式或原因。状语常常能够移动，但移动后要保持意思清楚。
名词短语可能不止一个词：the boy in a blue shirt作为一个整体可以作主语。现在进行时里的is reading是一个动词组合，不要把is单独当成完整意思。
例句与解析
1. The girl / reads / stories. 主语The girl，谓语动词reads，宾语stories。
2. The girl / is / quiet. 主语The girl，系动词is，表语quiet。
3. My little brother / is playing / football. My little brother是完整主语。
4. We read in the library after school. in the library补充地点；after school补充时间。
5. After school, we read in the library. 时间移到句首，主要意思不变。
6. The red bag is mine. red修饰bag；mine在is后说明归属。
对比辨析
He is a teacher.中的a teacher是表语，不是“被is做了某个动作”的宾语。I like the teacher.中的the teacher才是like的宾语。同一词组在不同句子里可以承担不同任务。

questions.prompt: 找出完整主语：The boy near the window is my brother.
questions.reference: The boy near the window。near the window修饰boy，属于整个主语短语。

questions.prompt: 找出宾语：My mother cooks dinner.
questions.reference: dinner。它是cooks这个动作涉及的对象。

questions.prompt: 指出表语：The flowers are beautiful.
questions.reference: beautiful。它在are后描述flowers。

questions.prompt: 指出时间状语：We played tennis yesterday.
questions.reference: yesterday。它说明动作发生的时间。

sections.title: 01.3 五种基本句型：把句子的主干补完整

blocks.text: 基本句型帮助判断一个句子有没有缺少关键部分。不是每个动词都能套进全部句型；需要结合动词的具体用法。先掌握常见例子，再认识名称。
规则详解
主谓：主语＋动词，动词的意思已经完整。主系表：主语＋系动词＋表语，后面必须说明状态或身份。主谓宾：动作需要说明对象。
主谓双宾：有些动词可同时说明“给谁”和“给什么”，如give、show。主谓宾补：宾语后再补充它的身份、状态或动作，如We call him Tom.。
双宾语常能变成含to或for的结构，但不能给所有动词都机械加同一介词。give通常配to；buy为某人买东西时常配for。
例句与解析
1. The baby sleeps. 宝宝睡觉。主谓结构，不需要再补一个宾语。
2. The baby is sleepy. 宝宝困了。主系表结构，sleepy描述状态。
3. The baby likes milk. 宝宝喜欢牛奶。主谓宾结构。
4. Mum gave me a book. = Mum gave a book to me. 妈妈给我一本书。
5. Dad bought me a bike. = Dad bought a bike for me. 爸爸给我买了一辆车。
6. We call the dog Snow. 我们叫这只狗Snow。Snow补充说明the dog的名字。
对比辨析
She is.若没有前文支撑，通常没说清“她是什么／怎么样”。She likes.通常也缺少喜欢的对象。简短回答Yes, she is.有前文提供信息，可以完整成立。

questions.prompt: 补全：The soup ___ delicious.
questions.reference: is / tastes都可构成合理句子。is作最基础答案；tastes是“尝起来”。

questions.prompt: 将Give me the ruler.改成含to的句子。
questions.reference: Give the ruler to me. 给出的物品在前，接受者放在to后。

questions.prompt: 将He bought a gift for me.改成双宾语句。
questions.reference: He bought me a gift. buy可用“人＋物”的双宾语结构。

questions.prompt: 判断Snow的作用：They call the cat Snow.
questions.reference: 宾语补足语。它说明the cat的名字。

sections.title: 01.4 英语语序：修饰词、时间和地点怎样摆

blocks.text: 英语通常用稳定的语序表达人物之间的关系。普通陈述句先说主语，再说谓语。名词前后出现的修饰语要放到合适位置，不能直接照搬中文词序。
规则详解
普通形容词常放名词前：a red bag。介词短语常放在被修饰名词后：the bag on the chair。多个修饰语一起出现时，先确保最基本的表达正确。
时间状语常在句首或句末；地点常放在动词或宾语后。一般情况下，实义动词与它的直接宾语之间不要随意插入很长的时间地点说明。
频率副词常在普通实义动词前、be后。特殊疑问句还涉及助动词位置，第08-09课有完整规则。
例句与解析
1. I have a blue schoolbag. 我有一个蓝色书包。blue在名词前。
2. The book on the desk is mine. 桌上的书是我的。on the desk修饰book。
3. I read books in my room every evening. 我每天晚上在房间里读书。
4. Every evening, I read books in my room. 时间也可以移到前面。
5. She often helps me. 她经常帮助我。often位于helps前。
6. She is often busy. 她经常很忙。often位于is后。
对比辨析
“我很喜欢英语”可说I like English very much.，不要写I very like English.。very可修饰形容词或部分副词，如very happy；这里用very much修饰喜欢的程度。

questions.prompt: 连词成句：a / she / red / has / bike
questions.reference: She has a red bike. 主语＋动词＋宾语，red修饰bike。

questions.prompt: 连词成句：usually / he / is / early
questions.reference: He is usually early. usually常在be之后。

questions.prompt: 改错：I very like reading.
questions.reference: I like reading very much. / I really like reading.

questions.prompt: 给book补充“桌上的”：The ___ is mine.
questions.reference: The book on the desk is mine. 介词短语放在book之后。
accepted: The book on the desk is mine

sections.title: 02 be、have、do：三个常用动词

blocks.text: be常用来说明身份、性质或状态；have可以表示“拥有”；do既能表示“做”，也能帮助其他动词构成问句和否定句。先看它在句中做什么。
规则
例句
I am eleven. 我十一岁。 / My brother is ten. 我弟弟十岁。
They are tired. 他们累了。 / She has a bike. 她有一辆自行车。
I do my homework after school. 这里do表示“做”。
Do you have a bike? 这里Do帮助提问，have表示“有”。
容易混淆
表达“我有一只猫”用 I have a cat.，不用 I am have a cat.。表达“你是学生吗”用 Are you a student?，不用 Do you are a student?。

questions.prompt: My parents ___ (am / is / are) busy.
questions.reference: are。parents是复数。

questions.prompt: Tom ___ (have / has) two pencils.
questions.reference: has。Tom是第三人称单数。

questions.prompt: 判断do的作用：Do you do your homework at home?
questions.reference: 第一个Do是助动词，帮助提问；第二个do是实义动词，表示“做”。
labels: 第一个 Do 的作用
第二个 do 的作用

sections.title: 02.1 be的用法：身份、状态、位置和动作组合

blocks.text: be不能只翻译成“是”。它在句子里有多种用途：连接主语与说明内容，或者参与构成特定的动词结构。判断是否需要be，要看整句话的结构。
规则详解
be后可接名词、形容词或表示位置的介词短语。年龄、天气、日期、时间等常见表达也经常使用be。
现在进行时必须用be＋动词-ing。be在这个结构里帮助说明进行中的动作。普通一般现在时里的play、live、like等，通常不再额外加be。
be的形式必须同时符合主语与时间：I am；he is；they are；过去用was/were。否定直接在be后加not；一般疑问句把be移到主语前。
例句与解析
1. She is a doctor. 身份：她是医生。
2. She is tired. 状态：她累了。
3. She is in the kitchen. 位置：她在厨房。
4. It is ten o'clock. 时间：现在十点。
5. It was cold yesterday. 天气与过去状态：昨天很冷。
6. She is cooking dinner. 进行中的动作：她正在做晚饭。
对比辨析
She cooks dinner every day.表达习惯；She is cooking dinner now.表达正在做。She is cook dinner.两种结构混合，错误。形容词afraid前需要be：He is afraid of dogs.。

questions.prompt: It ___ cold yesterday, but it ___ warm today.
questions.reference: was；is。前半句是昨天，后半句是今天。

questions.prompt: 把She is in the library.改为疑问句。
questions.reference: Is she in the library? 移动is，位置短语不变。

questions.prompt: 改错：He afraid of the dog.
questions.reference: He is afraid of the dog. afraid是形容词，前面需要be。
accepted: He is afraid of the dog

questions.prompt: 改错：They are go to school every day.
questions.reference: They go to school every day. 描述日常习惯，不加are。
accepted: They go to school every day

sections.title: 02.2 have：拥有、活动搭配与句型变化

blocks.text: have既可以表示拥有，也出现在一些活动搭配里。一般现在时第三人称单数用has；过去式是had。否定或提问时，通常借助do、does或did。
规则详解
表示拥有：have a bike、have two brothers。表示活动：have breakfast、have a class、have a rest。词组的中文意思取决于搭配。
一般现在时：I have → he has；疑问Does he have…?；否定He doesn't have…。过去时：He had…；Did he have…?；He didn't have…。
表示活动时，have可以用进行时，如We are having lunch.。表示静态拥有时，基础学习中通常说I have a bike.，不说I am having a bike.。
例句与解析
1. I have two sisters. 我有两个姐妹。
2. My sister has a new computer. 我姐姐有台新电脑。
3. Does your school have a library? 你们学校有图书馆吗？
4. We had an English class yesterday. 我们昨天上了英语课。
5. They are having breakfast now. 他们现在正在吃早饭。
6. Let's have a rest. 我们休息一下吧。
对比辨析
The school has a library.从学校拥有的设施说；There is a library in the school.从某处存在什么说。两句可以描述同一事实，但结构不同，不能写There has a library.。

questions.prompt: He ___ (have) a class every afternoon.
questions.reference: has。he作主语，描述经常发生的活动。

questions.prompt: Did you ___ (have) breakfast?
questions.reference: have。did后接原形。

questions.prompt: 改错：She doesn't has a bike.
questions.reference: She doesn't have a bike. doesn't后用原形。

questions.prompt: 根据“正在吃午饭”补全：We ___ lunch now.
questions.reference: are having。这里have表示吃饭这一活动，可用进行时。

sections.title: 03 名词：一个、多个，以及不可数

blocks.text: 名词给人、动物、物品、地方或想法取名字。可数名词可以直接数个数；不可数名词通常要借助单位来表示数量。看词在当前句子里的意思。
规则

rows: 不可数名词的常见用法
some water；some rice；a piece of paper

blocks.text: 例句
There are three children in the room. 房间里有三个孩子。
I need two glasses of water. 我需要两杯水。复数变化在glasses上。
This is Tom's bag. 这是汤姆的包。the teachers' office表示教师们的办公室。
容易混淆
常见基础用法中，不说 two milks 表示“两份牛奶”；可说 two glasses of milk。餐馆中“两杯某饮料”等特殊语境另论。本课先掌握通常用法。

questions.prompt: 写复数：box；baby；child。
questions.reference: boxes；babies；children。

questions.prompt: 填空：two ___ (glass) of juice。
questions.reference: glasses。glass表示杯子时可数，two后用复数。

questions.prompt: “莉莉的书包”怎样写？
questions.reference: Lily's schoolbag / Lily's bag。人名后加's表示所属。

sections.title: 03.1 名词复数：规则变化、特殊变化与固定复数

blocks.text: 可数名词有单数和复数。规则变化可以归纳，但少量常用词需要单独记忆。先确定名词是否表示多个，再考虑怎样变化。
规则详解
多数名词加-s。常见以s、x、sh、ch结尾的词加-es。辅音字母＋y变y为i再加-es；元音字母＋y通常直接加-s。
部分-f/-fe结尾词变成-ves，如leaf/leaves、knife/knives、life/lives；也有直接加-s的roof/roofs。-o结尾既有tomato/tomatoes、potato/potatoes，也有photo/photos、piano/pianos，不宜只套一条绝对规则。
常见特殊复数：man/men、woman/women、child/children、tooth/teeth、foot/feet、mouse/mice。sheep单复数同形。people表示“人们”时一般按复数使用。trousers、glasses等常用复数形式。
例句与解析
1. There are two buses outside. 外面有两辆公交车。bus加-es。
2. The babies are sleeping. 婴儿们在睡觉。baby变babies。
3. The boys have three toy cars. 男孩们有三辆玩具车。boys中的y保留。
4. There are five sheep on the farm. 农场有五只羊。sheep不加-s。
5. These trousers are new. 这条裤子是新的。trousers通常用复数。
6. This pair of trousers is new. 这条裤子是新的。主语中心是单数pair，所以用is。
对比辨析
a pair of shoes用is还是are，要看句子实际主语：This pair of shoes is…；These shoes are…。two pairs of shoes则用复数谓语。不要只盯着离动词最近的单词。

questions.prompt: 写复数：city；boy；leaf；photo。
questions.reference: cities；boys；leaves；photos。分别对应不同规则或常用特殊变化。

questions.prompt: 写复数：woman；tooth；sheep。
questions.reference: women；teeth；sheep。

questions.prompt: This pair of shoes ___ (is / are) small.
questions.reference: is。中心名词pair是单数。

questions.prompt: Two pairs of shoes ___ (is / are) under the bed.
questions.reference: are。中心名词pairs是复数。

sections.title: 03.2 可数与不可数：物品、材料与单位

blocks.text: 能否直接用one、two来数，是区别可数与不可数的一条线索。名词的可数性和它表达的具体意思有关，同一个词在不同语境里可能有不同用法。
规则详解
可数名词单数通常需要限定词，如a book、my book、this book，不能把普通单数可数名词随意裸放。不可数名词在一般用法中不直接加a/an，也不直接加-s。
常见不可数词：water、milk、rice、bread、homework、information、advice、weather。需要计量时使用a piece of、a cup of、a bowl of等结构，数量变化通常发生在单位名词上。
chicken表示活鸡时可数，表示鸡肉时常不可数；paper表示纸张材料时不可数；glass表示玻璃材料时不可数，表示杯子时可数。遇到新意思要重新判断。
例句与解析
1. I have a chicken. 我养了一只鸡。chicken是动物。
2. I would like some chicken. 我想要一些鸡肉。chicken是食物。
3. There is some bread on the table. 桌上有一些面包。
4. Please give me two pieces of paper. 请给我两张纸。pieces变复数。
5. The information is useful. 这些信息有用。information在这里作不可数名词。
6. I have a lot of homework today. 我今天有很多作业。homework不加-s。
对比辨析
“两条建议”用two pieces of advice，不用two advices；“很多作业”用much homework或a lot of homework。表示两杯咖啡的餐饮简略用法可以另学，先把基本单位结构掌握好。

questions.prompt: 改错：I have many homeworks.
questions.reference: I have a lot of homework. / I have much homework. homework不可数。
accepted: I have a lot of homework

questions.prompt: 填空：three ___ (piece) of bread。
questions.reference: pieces。计量单位piece根据three变复数。

questions.prompt: There ___ (is / are) some rice in the bowl.
questions.reference: is。rice在这里不可数。

questions.prompt: 判断chicken是否可数：Three chickens are eating.
questions.reference: 可数。句子在说三只活鸡。

sections.title: 03.3 名词所有格：谁的，以及共同还是分别拥有

blocks.text: 所有格表示所属、关系等，不只表示某个人真正拥有一件物品。Tom's teacher表示“汤姆的老师”，不是老师被汤姆拥有。
规则详解
单数名词以及不以-s结尾的复数名词，通常加's：the boy's bag、children's books。已经以-s结尾的复数名词，通常只加撇号：the girls' room。
两个人共同拥有一个对象，通常只在最后一个名字后加's：Tom and Lily's room。分别拥有时，两个人名分别用所有格：Tom's and Lily's rooms。实际单复数仍要根据意思判断。
of结构常说明事物之间的关系，如the door of the room。人的所属也常用's。所有格和名词性物主代词都可以在语境明确时独立使用，如This is Tom's.。
例句与解析
1. This is the girl's bag. 这是那个女孩的包。一个女孩。
2. These are the girls' bags. 这些是那些女孩的包。多个女孩。
3. Children's Day is in June. 儿童节在六月。children不是-s结尾。
4. This is Ben and Anna's house. 这是本和安娜共同的房子。
5. Ben's and Anna's bikes are new. 本的车和安娜的车都是新的。
6. The name of the book is interesting. 这本书的名字有趣。
对比辨析
The boys' teacher和the boy's teacher区别在于前者是“那些男孩的老师”，后者是“那个男孩的老师”。撇号的位置承载意思，不是随意的标点。

questions.prompt: 写出“孩子们的玩具”：___ toys。
questions.reference: children's。children为不规则复数，后加's。

questions.prompt: 写出“那些老师的办公室”：the ___ office。
questions.reference: teachers'。以-s结尾的复数名词后只加撇号。

questions.prompt: 表示Tom和Lucy共有一只猫：___ cat。
questions.reference: Tom and Lucy's。共有对象只在最后一个名字后加's。

questions.prompt: 改写：This bag belongs to Lily. 用Lily's表达。
questions.reference: This is Lily's bag. / This bag is Lily's.

sections.title: 04 冠词：a、an、the与不加冠词

blocks.text: 冠词放在名词前。a/an通常引出一个尚未特指的人或物；the通常表示双方知道或已经提到的对象。不是每个名词前都要加冠词。
规则

rows: 一个，且开头是辅音读音
一个，且开头是元音读音
已提到，或大家知道具体是哪一个
I have a dog. The dog is white.
常见固定表达不加冠词
泛指某一类复数／不可数事物时常不加

blocks.text: 例句
There is a book on the desk. 桌上有一本书。the desk指语境里那张桌子。
She is an English teacher. 她是一位英语老师。
This is my book. 这是我的书。my已经限定book，不再在my前加a。
容易混淆
a/an看读音，不只看字母：hour开头的h不发音，所以用an；useful开头的音类似“you”开头，所以用a。不要写 a apple 或 an useful book。

questions.prompt: 填a或an：___ orange；___ university。
questions.reference: an orange；a university。university开头是/j/这个辅音。

questions.prompt: I have a cat. ___ cat is black.
questions.reference: The。第二次提到同一只猫。

questions.prompt: 改错：This is a my pencil.
questions.reference: This is my pencil. 物主代词my与不定冠词a不这样叠加使用。

sections.title: 04.1 a与an：读音、首次提及与一类事物

blocks.text: a/an通常放在单数可数名词前，表示一个未特指的对象，或说明某人属于哪一类。选择a还是an，要听后面紧接单词的开头读音。
规则详解
后面的第一个音是元音时用an，是辅音时用a。关键不是第一个字母，也不是名词本身：a book变成an interesting book时，因为中间加了interesting，冠词也变化。
说明职业身份常用a/an：a teacher、an engineer。第一次提到一个对象常用a/an，后文再指同一个对象时常改为the。
a/an与one不完全相同。a/an常只是引出一个对象；one可以特别强调数量是一而不是二。泛指复数事物时不用把a机械保留。
例句与解析
1. He is a teacher. 他是一名老师。
2. She is an English teacher. 她是一名英语老师。紧接English的元音。
3. We waited for an hour. 我们等了一小时。hour开头h不发音。
4. It is a useful tool. 它是有用的工具。useful开头读音带辅音/j/。
5. I saw a dog. The dog was white. 先引入一只狗，再指回那一只。
6. I need one ticket, not two. 我需要一张票，不是两张。one强调数量。
对比辨析
不能写She is teacher.表示她是一名老师；可说She is a teacher.。但复数句They are teachers.通常不加a。This is my teacher.中my已经限定名词，也不再加a。

questions.prompt: 填冠词：___ old bike；___ new bike。
questions.reference: an；a。根据old和new开头的读音。

questions.prompt: 填冠词：___ hour；___ university。
questions.reference: an；a。hour以元音开头，university以辅音/j/开头。

questions.prompt: 改错：He is an useful person.
questions.reference: He is a useful person. useful开头不是元音。

questions.prompt: 把She is a doctor.改为复数。
questions.reference: They are doctors. 单复数相关成分一起变化。

sections.title: 04.2 the与零冠词：具体对象和一般类别

blocks.text: the常表示语境中明确的对象；零冠词指名词前不使用a/an/the。判断时先问“这句话说的是具体哪一个，还是一般的一类／一种活动”。
规则详解
已经提到的对象、由修饰语限定清楚的对象、语境里独一明确的对象，常用the。the也常出现在序数词和形容词最高级前，但如果已有my等限定词，结构会不同。
泛指复数可数名词或不可数名词时常用零冠词。日常三餐、球类运动、学校科目、许多专有名称等也常不加冠词。常见乐器表达通常用play the piano等。
go to school常指上学这项活动；go to the school指去那所学校这处地方。类似固定表达需要结合意思积累，不能只背“school前永远没有the”。
例句与解析
1. Please close the door. 请关门。现场知道是哪扇门。
2. The boy in the red shirt is my brother. 红衣男孩是我哥哥。修饰语限定了对象。
3. I like dogs. 我喜欢狗这一类动物。
4. The dogs in the garden are noisy. 花园里的那些狗很吵。特指。
5. We have lunch at twelve. 我们十二点吃午饭。
6. My father went to the school to meet my teacher. 爸爸去学校见老师，强调地点。
对比辨析
I like music.通常泛指音乐；I like the music in this film.指这部电影中的音乐。是否可数并不单独决定能否用the，语境中的特指关系也重要。

questions.prompt: 填the或“/”：I play ___ football after school.
questions.reference: /。常见球类运动表达不加冠词。

questions.prompt: 填the或“/”：She can play ___ piano.
questions.reference: the。常见乐器表达play the piano。

questions.prompt: 填the或“/”：___ water in this cup is warm.
questions.reference: The。in this cup明确指这一杯里的水。

questions.prompt: 改错：This is the my second visit.
questions.reference: This is my second visit. my已限定visit，不再叠加the。

sections.title: 05 代词：I、me、my、mine分别放哪里

blocks.text: 代词可以代替已经知道的人或事物。先问：它在说“谁”，还是“谁的”？如果表示“谁的”，再看后面有没有名词。
规则
例句
She likes me. 她喜欢我。She是主语，me是likes的宾语。
This is my pen. = This pen is mine. 这是我的钢笔。
I play with him. 我和他一起玩。介词with后用him。
容易混淆
my后面要接名词；mine后面不再重复同一个名词。its表示“它的”；it's通常是it is的缩写：The cat is small. Its tail is long. It's cute.

questions.prompt: This is ___ (she) book. The red one is ___ (I).
questions.reference: her；mine。book前用her；第二空独立表示“我的”。

questions.prompt: Please help ___ (we).
questions.reference: us。help后用宾格。

questions.prompt: ___ (They / Them) are my friends.
questions.reference: They。句首作主语。

sections.title: 05.1 人称代词：主格、宾格与指代一致

blocks.text: 人称代词的形式取决于在句子里的位置和作用。主格通常作主语；宾格通常在及物动词或介词后。理解who做了什么，比死背一排词更重要。
规则详解
主格：I、you、he、she、it、we、they。宾格：me、you、him、her、it、us、them。you和it主宾格形式相同，但作用不同。
and连接两个人称成分时，每个成分仍应符合它所在的位置：Lily and I作主语；with Lily and me中me在介词with后。
代词必须让读者知道指谁。人称与单复数保持一致；my parents通常对应they/them，my father通常对应he/him。不清楚时重复名字比随意更换代词更准确。
例句与解析
1. He knows me. 他认识我。he作主语，me作宾语。
2. I know him. 我认识他。位置改变，形式也改变。
3. Please listen to her. 请听她说。her在介词to后。
4. Lily and I are classmates. 莉莉和我是同学。
5. The teacher talked to Lily and me. 老师和莉莉、我交谈了。
6. My parents are busy. I help them at home. parents用them指回。
对比辨析
“Me and Lily are…”在日常口语中可听到，但本阶段规范书面练习宜用Lily and I are…。比较句可用She is taller than me.，也可用She is taller than I am.；后者保留完整小句。

questions.prompt: ___ (We / Us) like music.
questions.reference: We。作主语。

questions.prompt: Please come with ___ (I / me).
questions.reference: me。位于介词with之后。

questions.prompt: My friends are here. Can you see ___ (they / them)?
questions.reference: them。作see的宾语，并指回复数friends。

questions.prompt: 选词：Tom and (I / me) are in Class One.
questions.reference: I。Tom and I共同作主语。

sections.title: 05.2 my与mine：所属、替代与whose问句

blocks.text: 形容词性物主代词后面通常接名词；名词性物主代词可以独立代替“物主代词＋名词”。两者表达的所属关系相同，句子位置不同。
规则详解
my book可由mine替代；your bag可由yours替代；her pen可由hers替代。his既可在名词前，也可独立使用。its通常用在名词前，不作为本阶段独立使用的重点。
所属代词根据拥有者决定，而不是根据物品的性别或数量决定。一本书是她的，用her book；几本书是她的，也用her books。
whose询问所属；who's常是who is的缩写。his、hers、yours、ours、theirs不加所有格撇号。
例句与解析
1. This is my coat. This coat is mine. 两句都表示这件外套属于我。
2. Those are her shoes. Those shoes are hers. hers替代her shoes。
3. This is his ruler. This ruler is his. his两种位置形式相同。
4. Our classroom is bigger than theirs. theirs代替their classroom。
5. Whose pencil is this? It is Anna's. 这是谁的铅笔？安娜的。
6. Who's that girl? She is Anna. 那个女孩是谁？who's询问身份。
对比辨析
This is mine book.错误，因为mine后不能这样再接book。Its tail is long.中的its表示“它的”；It's a cat.中的it's是it is。把缩写和所属混淆，会改变整个句子结构。

questions.prompt: This pen is ___ (my / mine).
questions.reference: mine。这里没有紧跟的名词。

questions.prompt: Those are ___ (their / theirs) books.
questions.reference: their。后面有books。

questions.prompt: ___ (Whose / Who's) your English teacher?
questions.reference: Who's。意思是Who is your English teacher?。

questions.prompt: 改错：The red schoolbag is her's.
questions.reference: The red schoolbag is hers. hers不加撇号。

sections.title: 06 this、that与some、any：指清楚、说数量

blocks.text: this/that帮助我们指出对象；these/those是对应的复数。some/any常表示一些数量，选择时要看句子的实际语气和用途。
规则

rows: 常用于肯定句：I have some apples.
常用于一般询问或否定：Do you have any milk?
Would you like some tea?；Can I have some water?

blocks.text: 例句
These are my shoes. 这些是我的鞋。 / That is his bike. 那是他的自行车。
Are those your books? Yes, they are. 回答时可用they。
There isn't any water in the bottle. 瓶子里没有水。
容易混淆
不能把some/any背成“所有疑问句都用any”。Would you like some juice? 是自然的邀请。this与is搭配，these与are搭配。

questions.prompt: 把 This is a box. 改为复数。
questions.reference: These are boxes. this、is、a box分别变成these、are、boxes。

questions.prompt: Would you like ___ (some / any) bread?
questions.reference: some。这里在礼貌地提供食物。

questions.prompt: There aren't ___ (some / any) chairs here.
questions.reference: any。普通否定句表示没有椅子。

sections.title: 06.1 some、any、each、every、both与all

blocks.text: 这些词帮助表示不确定数量、每一个或全部。它们对后面的名词形式和谓语可能有要求，不能只记中文意思。
规则详解
some/any可以接可数名词复数或不可数名词。some常用于肯定陈述、礼貌请求或提供；any常用于一般询问和否定，也可在肯定句中表示“任何一个”。
each强调分别看每一个；every强调一个不漏地看整个群体。each/every后接单数可数名词时，整个主语一般用单数谓语：Every student has…；Each child is…。
both通常说两者都，all常说三个及以上的全部，或不可数事物的全部。both of them作主语时用复数谓语；all the water作主语时通常用单数谓语。
例句与解析
1. There are some oranges in the basket. 篮子里有一些橙子。
2. Do you have any questions? 你有问题吗？
3. You can choose any book here. 这里的书你可以任选一本。
4. Every student has a notebook. 每个学生都有一本笔记本。
5. Both of my parents work here. 我父母两人都在这里工作。
6. All the water is clean. 所有这些水都是干净的。
对比辨析
Both students are here.用复数students和are；Each student is here.用单数student和is。表示“全部”不代表谓语一定用复数，要看名词是可数复数还是不可数。

questions.prompt: Every child ___ (has / have) a ticket.
questions.reference: has。Every child按单数处理。

questions.prompt: Both of them ___ (is / are) ready.
questions.reference: are。both of them表示两个人。

questions.prompt: Would you like ___ (some / any) tea?
questions.reference: some。这里礼貌提供饮料。

questions.prompt: All the milk ___ (is / are) in the fridge.
questions.reference: is。milk为不可数名词。

sections.title: 06.2 反身代词与one：避免重复而不混淆对象

blocks.text: 当动作回到主语自己身上时，可用反身代词；当需要避免重复某个可数名词时，可以在适当语境中用one或ones。这两类词的任务不同。
规则详解
常见反身代词：myself、yourself、himself、herself、itself、ourselves、yourselves、themselves。by oneself表示独自；enjoy oneself表示玩得愉快。
one/ones可代替前文提到的某类可数名词，常带修饰语：the red one、the small ones。it/them通常指回已经明确的具体对象。
another常表示另一个；the other常在两者中指剩下的那个。详细的other/others用法可以随课文扩展，这里先建立基本区别。
例句与解析
1. I can do it myself. 我可以自己做，强调亲自完成。
2. She looked at herself in the mirror. 她看着镜中的自己。
3. We enjoyed ourselves at the party. 我们在聚会上玩得愉快。
4. I lost my pen. I need a new one. 我丢了钢笔，需要一支新的，同类而非同一支。
5. I found my pen. It was under the desk. it指找回的那支钢笔。
6. I have two bags. One is red, and the other is blue. 两个中的另一个。
对比辨析
I like him.通常指我喜欢另一个男性；He likes himself.表示他喜欢自己。himself不能只因为主语是he就随意取代所有him，要看两者是否指同一对象。

questions.prompt: She can dress ___ (her / herself).（她能自己穿衣服）
questions.reference: herself。动作回到她自己。

questions.prompt: We enjoyed ___ (ourselves / yourselves).
questions.reference: ourselves。与主语we对应。

questions.prompt: This pen is broken. I need a new ___.
questions.reference: one。代替同类的一支pen。

questions.prompt: I have two pencils. One is short; ___ is long.
questions.reference: the other。明确的两支铅笔中剩下的一支。

sections.title: 07 一般现在时：习惯、事实与状态

blocks.text: 一般现在时常说明平时怎样、长期事实或目前的状态。先看主语是不是he/she/it或一个人、一个事物，再决定实义动词是否用第三人称单数形式。
规则
例句
I read every evening. 我每天晚上读书。
My sister reads every evening. 我姐姐每天晚上读书。
They live near the school. 他们住在学校附近。
The sun rises in the east. 太阳从东方升起。
容易混淆
“名字不是he，所以动词不加s”是错误想法。Tom likes music. 中Tom相当于he；My parents like music. 中parents是复数，不用likes。

questions.prompt: She ___ (study) English every day.
questions.reference: studies。study变y为i，加-es。

questions.prompt: My parents ___ (work) in a school.
questions.reference: work。parents为复数。

questions.prompt: 把 I have a bike. 改成以He开头。
questions.reference: He has a bike. have的第三人称单数是has。

sections.title: 07.1 一般现在时的三种意思与常见时间表达

blocks.text: 一般现在时并不表示所有“现在正在做”的动作。它最常说明日常习惯、长期事实和目前的状态。理解句意后，再选择动词形式。
规则详解
习惯或重复活动常和every day、on Sundays、usually、often等连用。状态包括喜好、认识、拥有、居住等；本阶段常用like、know、want、have、live的一般现在时。
普遍事实也用一般现在时，如The Earth goes around the Sun.。第三人称单数变化来自主语，不是因为出现了every day。
sometimes、every day等词提供线索，但不能脱离句意。一天发生一次的活动可以描述为习惯；正在描述眼前的一次动作时，可能改用进行时。
例句与解析
1. I walk to school every day. 我每天步行上学，是习惯。
2. He walks to school every day. 换成he，walk变walks。
3. My grandparents live in a small town. 表达目前的居住状态。
4. I know the answer. 我知道答案，通常不用am knowing。
5. Water freezes at 0°C under standard conditions. 这是一般事实表达。
6. She usually drinks tea, but she is drinking milk now. 平时习惯与当前动作对照。
对比辨析
I am liking English.不作为本阶段表达一般喜好的常规形式；用I like English.。一些动词在特殊含义或特定语境中能用进行时，基础阶段先掌握最常见的状态用法。

questions.prompt: She usually ___ (drink) milk in the morning.
questions.reference: drinks。习惯表达，she是第三人称单数。

questions.prompt: My friends ___ (live) near the school.
questions.reference: live。主语friends是复数。

questions.prompt: 改错：He is knowing my name.
questions.reference: He knows my name. 常规状态表达用一般现在时。

questions.prompt: 选择：I (want / am wanting) some water.
questions.reference: want。这里表示当前愿望，常用一般现在时。

sections.title: 07.2 主谓一致：先找主语中心，再看动词

blocks.text: 主谓一致指动词形式要与主语在人称、数等方面相配。主语里出现多个名词时，应先找到真正的中心，不能只看离动词最近的一个词。
规则详解
A and B通常表示两个对象，作主语时用复数谓语。表示一个对象的名词短语，即使后面带修饰短语，通常仍用单数谓语。
a pair of shoes的中心是pair；two pairs的中心是pairs。each/every＋单数名词通常用单数谓语。不可数名词通常按单数处理。
with等介词带出的附加对象一般不改变主语的数：The girl with two dogs is…。there be句型的列举形式另看第15课。
例句与解析
1. Tom and Lily are classmates. 两个人，所以用are。
2. The girl with two dogs is my friend. 主语中心是girl，不是dogs。
3. The books on the desk are mine. 主语中心是books。
4. A pair of shoes is under the bed. 中心是a pair。
5. Every student needs a pencil. Every student按单数处理。
6. The water in the bottles is clean. 中心是不可数water，不是bottles。
对比辨析
The name of my friends is…与The names of my friends are…分别以name和names为中心，表达的意思也不同。先看完整意思，再找主语中心，不要只靠背位置口诀。

questions.prompt: The boy with his parents ___ (is / are) here.
questions.reference: is。主语中心boy是单数，with his parents是附加说明。

questions.prompt: The apples in the bag ___ (is / are) fresh.
questions.reference: are。主语中心apples是复数。

questions.prompt: Every child ___ (need / needs) water.
questions.reference: needs。Every child为单数。

questions.prompt: Two glasses of milk ___ (is / are) on the table.
questions.reference: are。主语中心是two glasses。

sections.title: 08 否定与一般疑问：三条路不要混

blocks.text: 把句子变成“不是／不做”或“是不是／做不做”时，先找动词结构。含be、含情态动词、一般现在时里的普通实义动词，处理方式不同。
规则
例句
Are you ready? Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. 你准备好了吗？
Does he live here? Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't. 他住这儿吗？
Can they dance? Yes, they can. / No, they can't. 他们会跳舞吗？
容易混淆
用了does/doesn't，后面的动词回到原形：Does she like…?，不是 Does she likes…?。含be的句子直接处理be，不写 Do you are…?。

questions.prompt: 把 He likes milk. 改为否定句。
questions.reference: He doesn't like milk. does后用原形like。

questions.prompt: 把 They are students. 改为一般疑问句。
questions.reference: Are they students? 把are移到主语前。

questions.prompt: 回答：Does Amy play tennis?（作否定回答）
questions.reference: No, she doesn't. 用与does对应的简短回答。

sections.title: 08.1 助动词选择：be、do、does、did怎样区分

blocks.text: 构成否定或疑问时，先看原句的谓语结构。已经有be或情态动词的句子，可直接处理它们；普通实义动词的一般现在和过去表达，通常需要do/does/did。
规则详解
含be：把be移到主语前提问，在be后加not否定。含can/must等：通常同样处理情态动词。be既可能独立连接状态，也可能出现在进行时里。
普通实义动词：一般现在时I/you/we/they用do，第三人称单数用does；一般过去时用did。加入does/did后，时态和主语的变化由它承担，后面的实义动词回到原形。
do自己表示“做”时，也可能需要另一个do帮助提问：Do you do your homework here?前一个do是助动词，后一个是实义动词。
例句与解析
1. She is at home. → Is she at home? / She isn't at home.
2. She is reading. → Is she reading? / She isn't reading.
3. She can read. → Can she read? / She can't read.
4. She reads every day. → Does she read every day?
5. She read the book yesterday. → Did she read the book yesterday?
6. He does his homework at home. → Does he do his homework at home?
对比辨析
不能同时让does和后面的普通动词都带第三人称单数变化；也不能在已经有is的普通be句前再加do。Does she is tired?应改为Is she tired?。

questions.prompt: 把He does his homework after dinner.改为疑问句。
questions.reference: Does he do his homework after dinner? 前does帮助提问，后do表示做。
accepted: Does he do his homework after dinner

questions.prompt: 把They were tired.改为否定句。
questions.reference: They weren't tired. / They were not tired.

questions.prompt: 改错：Did he played football?
questions.reference: Did he play football? did后用原形。

questions.prompt: 改错：Do you are reading?
questions.reference: Are you reading? 进行时直接移动are。

sections.title: 08.2 否定表达：not、no、never和not all

blocks.text: 否定有多种表达方式。not通常参与谓语的否定；no常直接限定名词；never表示从不。选择哪一种，要看否定的内容和句子结构。
规则详解
be后加not：is not；普通实义动词一般借助do not、does not、did not。no可放在名词前表示没有：no books、no water。
never本身带否定意义，在本阶段标准表达中通常不再叠加don't来表达“从不”。I never go there.已经完整表达从不去。
否定多个并列对象时常用or：I don't like tea or coffee.。not all表示“并非所有”，不是“所有都不”；理解范围能避免误读。
例句与解析
1. There isn't any water. = There is no water. 都表示没有水。
2. He never eats fish. 他从不吃鱼。eats仍根据he变化。
3. She is never late. 她从不迟到。never常在be后。
4. I don't have a pen or a pencil. 我既没有钢笔也没有铅笔。
5. Not all the students like football. 并非所有学生都喜欢足球。
6. No students are in the classroom. 教室里没有学生。
对比辨析
I don't never go there.不作为本阶段表示“我从不去那里”的规范写法。no与not不能随意交换：He is not tired.，不能写He is no tired.。

questions.prompt: 改错：She is no happy.
questions.reference: She is not happy. / She isn't happy. 形容词前在be后用not。

questions.prompt: 同义改写：There aren't any books. 用no。
questions.reference: There are no books. no直接限定books。

questions.prompt: 改错：I don't never eat fish.
questions.reference: I never eat fish. never已经带否定意义。

questions.prompt: 翻译Not all the books are new.
questions.reference: 并非所有的书都是新的。意思是至少有一部分不是新的，并非全部旧。

sections.title: 09 特殊疑问句：你到底想问什么

blocks.text: 先想清缺少哪条信息，再选择疑问词。大多数本阶段特殊疑问句可理解为“疑问词＋相应的一般疑问句语序”。询问主语时有不同形式。
规则

rows: how often：How often do you read?

blocks.text: 例句
Where does he live? 他住在哪里？does后用live。
What are they doing? 他们在做什么？保留are doing结构。
How many books do you have? 你有多少本书？
Who lives here? 谁住这儿？who直接问主语，不机械地补do。
容易混淆
How long常问“多长时间／多长”；How far问距离。回答why时可以说 Because it is fun.。不要把中文语序直接变成 Where he lives?。

questions.prompt: 对地点提问：She lives in Beijing.
questions.reference: Where does she live? 提问地点用where，does后用live。

questions.prompt: 问“三本书”的数量，应选How many还是How much？
questions.reference: How many。books是可数名词复数。

questions.prompt: 填空：___ do you like pandas? Because they are cute.
questions.reference: Why。回答说明原因。

sections.title: 09.1 who问主语，who问宾语：结构为什么不同

blocks.text: 疑问词问的对象在原句中承担不同任务，问句结构可能不同。先把答案放回句子，看它原来是主语、宾语、地点还是时间。
规则详解
问主语：将主语替换成who/what，通常保留陈述句的基本动词顺序，如Tom lives here. → Who lives here?。
问普通实义动词的宾语或其他信息时，一般需要相应助动词：You know Tom. → Who do you know?。
含be或进行时的句子仍要看疑问词所问角色：Who is reading?问正在读的人；What is he reading?问读的内容。
例句与解析
1. Tom helps Lily. → Who helps Lily? 谁帮助莉莉？问主语Tom。
2. Tom helps Lily. → Who does Tom help? 汤姆帮助谁？问宾语Lily。
3. Lily called me yesterday. → Who called you yesterday? 谁打给你？
4. You called Lily yesterday. → Who did you call yesterday? 你打给谁？
5. The boy is drawing a cat. → Who is drawing a cat? 谁在画猫？
6. The boy is drawing a cat. → What is the boy drawing? 男孩在画什么？
对比辨析
普通、中性的Who lives here?不需要再加does。Who does live here?在特定强调语境可以出现，但不是本阶段最常规的主语提问形式。

questions.prompt: 对Tom提问：Tom plays the piano.
questions.reference: Who plays the piano? who代替主语，plays保留。

questions.prompt: 对Lily提问：He knows Lily.
questions.reference: Who does he know? 对宾语提问，does后用know。

questions.prompt: 对主语提问：My mother cooked dinner.
questions.reference: Who cooked dinner? 询问过去动作的执行者。

questions.prompt: 对宾语提问：She is reading a story.
questions.reference: What is she reading? what询问阅读内容。

sections.title: 09.2 how系列问句：方式、数量、距离、时长与频率

blocks.text: how后接不同的词，询问的信息会变化。回答的单位是很好的检查线索：kilometres是距离，minutes可能是时长，twice a week是频率。
规则详解
How问方式或状态；How many接可数名词复数，How much可以问不可数数量，也可以问价格。
How long可以问时长或物体长度；How far问距离；How often问频率。What time通常问具体钟点，When可问更宽泛的时间。
How soon询问从现在起过多久，常在将来语境中用in＋一段时间回答。这属于衔接表达，可先和How long区分意思。
例句与解析
1. How do you go to school? By bus. 问方式。
2. How far is your school? About two kilometres away. 问距离。
3. How long does it take? About twenty minutes. 问耗时。
4. How often do you swim? Twice a week. 问频率。
5. What time do you get up? At seven. 问钟点。
6. How soon will he come back? In two days. 问从现在起多久以后。
对比辨析
Twenty minutes' walk表示步行二十分钟的路程，虽然用了minutes，回答的可能是距离。不能只见到某个单词就固定选择疑问词，要先理解完整答案。

questions.prompt: 提问“两公里”：___ is it from here to school?
questions.reference: How far。询问距离。

questions.prompt: 提问“一周三次”：___ do you exercise?
questions.reference: How often。询问发生频率。

questions.prompt: 提问“十元”：___ is this notebook?
questions.reference: How much。询问价格。

questions.prompt: 提问“半小时的耗时”：___ does the bus ride take?
questions.reference: How long。询问路程所花的时间。

sections.title: 09.3 简短回答、选择疑问句和真实信息

blocks.text: 回答问句时，要与问句里的主语、助动词和实际事实对应。选择疑问句通常从给出的选项中选择，而不是只答Yes或No。
规则详解
含be的问句，用对应be回答；含do/does/did的问句，用对应助动词回答；含can等的问句，用对应情态动词回答。
对you提问，回答自己时常改成I或we；对this/that提问常用it；对these/those提问常用they。英语的Yes/No应与后面肯定或否定事实一致。
选择疑问句用or连接选项：Do you want tea or milk?可答Tea, please.。对提供帮助、邀请等问题，还可以使用合适的交际回答。
例句与解析
1. Are you a student? Yes, I am. 询问you，回答自己用I。
2. Is this your bag? No, it isn't. 用it指回this bag。
3. Did they go out? Yes, they did. 用did对应过去的提问。
4. Can she swim? No, she can't. 与can相对应。
5. Do you want tea or milk? Milk, please. 选择其中一项。
6. Don't you like cats? Yes, I do. 这里明确表示“我喜欢猫”。
对比辨析
Yes, I am.中的am不能在这个句末肯定简答里缩成Yes, I'm.。否定回答No, I'm not.自然。类似地用Yes, he is.，不写Yes, he's.作为完整简短回答。

questions.prompt: Are these your books? 作肯定回答。
questions.reference: Yes, they are. 用they指回these books。

questions.prompt: Does she play tennis? 作否定回答。
questions.reference: No, she doesn't. 与does对应。

questions.prompt: Did you stay home? 用I作肯定回答。
questions.reference: Yes, I did. 与过去的did对应。

questions.prompt: Do you want the red one or the blue one? 选择蓝色。
questions.reference: The blue one, please. 直接回答所选对象。
accepted: I want the blue one, please

sections.title: 10 现在进行时：正在发生的动作

blocks.text: 要说“此刻正在做什么”，常用am/is/are＋动词-ing。be与-ing共同组成这个结构，任何一部分都不能随意漏掉。
规则

rows: 常见不发音的e结尾，去e再加-ing
部分重读闭音节词，双写末尾辅音
不是所有辅音结尾都双写

blocks.text: 例句
I am reading now. 我现在正在读书。
She isn't watching TV. 她现在没在看电视。
Are they playing football? Yes, they are. 他们正在踢球吗？
I read every evening. / I am reading now. 前句是习惯，后句是当前动作。
容易混淆
错：She reading.；She is read.。对：She is reading.。like、want、know等在本阶段表达喜好、想法时通常用一般现在时，如 I like music.。

questions.prompt: Look! Tom ___ (swim).
questions.reference: is swimming。Tom用is，swim要双写m再加-ing。

questions.prompt: 改为否定：They are running.
questions.reference: They aren't running. 在are后加not。

questions.prompt: 选词：She (reads / is reading) every night.
questions.reference: reads。这里说每天晚上的习惯。

sections.title: 10.1 -ing拼写：去e、双写、保留y与特殊变化

blocks.text: 动词-ing形式可以出现在进行时，也可以出现在某些动词或介词后。先识别动词原形，再按拼写规律变化，不能看到末尾辅音就全部双写。
规则详解
多数动词直接加-ing：read/reading、play/playing、study/studying。结尾y一般保留；它不同于部分第三人称单数和过去式中y变i的规则。
许多以不发音e结尾的词去e加-ing：make/making、write/writing。see/seeing、agree/agreeing等保留结尾元音字母。
部分重读闭音节词在末尾形成“一个元音字母＋一个辅音字母”时双写末尾辅音：run/running、begin/beginning。末尾w、x、y一般不按此双写；open/opening、visit/visiting末音节不重读。lie/lying、tie/tying是常见特殊变化。
例句与解析
1. He is studying English. study变studying，保留y。
2. She is making a cake. make去e再加-ing。
3. They are running. run双写n。
4. We are opening the door. open不双写n。
5. The baby is lying on the bed. lie变lying。
6. I enjoy swimming. swimming的拼写和进行时里相同，但整句不是进行时。
对比辨析
有-ing不等于一定是现在进行时。I like reading.中谓语是like，reading是like后面的形式；I am reading.中的am reading才是进行时结构。

questions.prompt: 写-ing：write；play；study。
questions.reference: writing；playing；studying。

questions.prompt: 写-ing：run；open；swim。
questions.reference: running；opening；swimming。

questions.prompt: 写-ing：lie；see。
questions.reference: lying；seeing。

questions.prompt: 判断时态：She enjoys dancing.
questions.reference: 一般现在时。谓语是enjoys，dancing是动词搭配的一部分。

sections.title: 10.2 习惯与眼前动作：同一人物，两种表达

blocks.text: 一般现在时和现在进行时可以谈同一个人，但表达角度不同。前者常说明通常情况或状态；后者常说明此刻或这一阶段正在进行的活动。
规则详解
now、Look!、Listen!等常提示当前动作；usually、every day等常提示习惯。但最终以句意为准，而不是只找关键词。
同一段里可以先说通常习惯，再说今天的不同安排。每个小句分别判断主语、时间和动词结构。
状态动词如know、want、like在本阶段常用一般现在时。进行时还可描述当前一段时间的暂时活动，不一定说话这一秒正在做：He is learning French this year.。
例句与解析
1. I walk to school every day. 我每天步行上学。
2. I am walking to school now. 我现在正在步行去学校。
3. Mum usually cooks dinner, but Dad is cooking tonight. 平时妈妈做，今晚爸爸正在做。
4. She works in a school. 她在学校工作，描述较稳定情况。
5. She is working at home today. 她今天在家工作，描述当天安排。
6. I know that boy. 我认识那个男孩，用know表达状态。
对比辨析
She is reading every night.在某些暂时性、特殊强调语境可能成立；初学题若单纯描述日常习惯，通常用She reads every night.。不能只凭时间词宣布所有其他表达都绝对错误。

questions.prompt: He usually ___ (take) a bus to school.
questions.reference: takes。一般习惯，he用第三人称单数。

questions.prompt: Look! He ___ (run) to the bus stop.
questions.reference: is running。眼前正在进行，run双写n。

questions.prompt: I ___ (know / am knowing) the answer.
questions.reference: know。常见状态表达。

questions.prompt: 翻译：她平时喝茶，但现在正在喝水。
questions.reference: She usually drinks tea, but she is drinking water now.
accepted: She usually drinks tea, but she is drinking water now
She usually drinks tea, but now she is drinking water

sections.title: 11 一般过去时①：过去是什么、怎么样

blocks.text: 先学含be的过去表达：am/is变成was，are变成were。它可以说明过去的身份、状态、位置等。
规则
例句
It is sunny today. It was rainy yesterday. 今天晴，昨天有雨。
We were in the park last Sunday. 上周日我们在公园。
Was he busy? Yes, he was. 他当时忙吗？
Were you at home? No, I wasn't. 你当时在家吗？不在。
容易混淆
含was/were的句子不用再加did：Was she tired? 正确；Did she was tired? 错误。回答Were you…?时，若说“我”，要用I was/wasn't。

questions.prompt: I ___ (am / was / were) tired yesterday.
questions.reference: was。时间是过去，主语是I。

questions.prompt: 把 They were at home. 改为一般疑问句。
questions.reference: Were they at home? 把were移到主语前。

questions.prompt: 回答：Were you busy yesterday?（用I作肯定回答）
questions.reference: Yes, I was. 主语从问句的you换成回答的I。

sections.title: 11.1 过去的状态与变化：was、were和ago

blocks.text: 过去的身份、情绪、位置、天气和存在情况，经常使用was/were。把现在与过去并排，可以看清到底改变了什么。
规则详解
I/he/she/it和普通单数主语用was；you/we/they和复数主语用were。现在am/is/are与过去was/were的选择同时受时间和主语影响。
ago放在表示时长的词组后：two days ago、three years ago。last week、yesterday等词组也交代过去时间，它们前面通常不再加in或on。
there was/were表示过去某处有。现在数量和过去数量可能不同：There was one tree before. There are three trees now.。
例句与解析
1. I was short three years ago. I am taller now. 三年前矮，现在高些。
2. My grandparents were teachers. 我的祖父母过去是教师。
3. It was sunny yesterday, but it is rainy today. 昨晴今雨。
4. There was no library here ten years ago. 十年前这里没有图书馆。
5. Were you at the park yesterday? No, I was at home. 纠正过去的位置。
6. Where were they last night? They were at the cinema. 询问过去位置。
对比辨析
He was play football yesterday.错误，因为was不能直接和动词原形play构成这种过去表达。讲过去踢了球，用He played football yesterday.；过去进行时另有was playing结构，不在这里混用。

questions.prompt: My father ___ a student twenty years ago.
questions.reference: was。过去时间，主语father为单数。

questions.prompt: There ___ two shops here last year.
questions.reference: were。two shops为复数。

questions.prompt: 改错：I was here in two days ago.
questions.reference: I was here two days ago. ago时间表达前不用in。
accepted: I was here two days ago

questions.prompt: 对地点提问：They were in the classroom.
questions.reference: Where were they? 对过去位置提问，移动were。

sections.title: 12 一般过去时②：过去做了什么

blocks.text: 描述已经发生的动作，肯定句通常使用动词过去式。本阶段常见过去式不随I、he、they等主语改变。疑问和否定用did/didn't时，后面的动词用原形。
规则

rows: 部分词双写末尾辅音再加-ed

blocks.text: 例句
She visited her grandparents yesterday. 她昨天看望了祖父母。
They went to the zoo last week. 他们上周去了动物园。
Did you see the film? No, I didn't. 你看过那部电影吗？没有。
He didn't go out yesterday. 他昨天没有出门。
容易混淆
错：Did you went there?；He didn't played.。对：Did you go there?；He didn't play.。不要给不规则过去式再加-ed，如不能写 goed。

questions.prompt: We ___ (go) to the park yesterday.
questions.reference: went。go的过去式是went。

questions.prompt: 改为否定：She watched TV last night.
questions.reference: She didn't watch TV last night. didn't后用watch。
accepted: She didn't watch TV last night

questions.prompt: 填空：What did he ___ (eat)?
questions.reference: eat。did后用原形。

sections.title: 12.1 过去式：规则拼写、-ed读音和不规则分组

blocks.text: 过去式需要同时掌握词形和读音。规则动词的-ed并非一律读成同一个音；不规则动词可以分组记，但不能凭某一组推断全部新词。
规则详解
拼写：多数加-ed；已有不发音e时加-d；辅音字母＋y变y为i再加-ed；部分重读闭音节词双写末尾辅音再加-ed。play/played保留y，stop/stopped双写p。
-ed读音看原形末尾的音：以/t/或/d/音结尾，通常读/ɪd/；其他清辅音后通常读/t/；其他浊辅音或元音后通常读/d/。先听教材录音确认，再模仿。
不规则分组：原形过去式同形put/put、cut/cut；元音改变sing/sang、drink/drank；-ought/-aught组buy/bought、teach/taught；完全明显变化go/went。read/read拼写相同、读音不同。
例句与解析
1. I played football. played末尾-ed读/d/，不是额外完整的“德”。
2. She watched TV. watched末尾-ed读/t/。
3. We wanted some water. wanted末尾-ed读/ɪd/。
4. He needed help. needed末尾-ed读/ɪd/。
5. They stopped at the gate. stop双写p再加-ed。
6. I bought a book and read it. bought是buy的过去式；read在这里也是过去式。
对比辨析
词形变化和读音变化是两件相关但不同的事：read/read看起来一样，过去式读/red/。did后则回到原形read，按原形读/riːd/。

questions.prompt: 写过去式：study；play；stop；live。
questions.reference: studied；played；stopped；lived。

questions.prompt: 写过去式：go；buy；cut；teach。
questions.reference: went；bought；cut；taught。

questions.prompt: wanted与watched的-ed是否读音相同？
questions.reference: 不同。wanted读/ɪd/，watched读/t/。

questions.prompt: 填空：Did you ___ (buy) the book?
questions.reference: buy。did后使用原形。

sections.title: 12.2 过去经历：多个动作、否定与提问

blocks.text: 叙述过去经历时，同一过去时间里的主要动作通常使用过去式。但句中不是每一个动词都要变过去式：搭配、情态动词和不定式各有自己的规则。
规则详解
并列发生的过去动作通常分别变化：We went to the park and played football.。否定与提问使用did/didn't，后面的普通实义动词用原形。
want to do等结构中，前面的want可以变wanted，to后面仍是原形。can的过去形式could可表达过去的能力，could后仍用原形。
first、then、after that、finally等词帮助组织顺序。时间已经清楚后，不必每句话都重复yesterday，但动词仍要保持相应的时间关系。
例句与解析
1. Yesterday, I got up early and had breakfast. got、had都表示过去动作。
2. Then I went to the park and met my friend. went和met是过去式。
3. We wanted to play football. wanted表示过去的愿望，to play保持原形。
4. It started to rain, so we went home. 下雨是回家的原因。
5. We didn't play football that day. didn't后用play。
6. What did you do after that? I read a book at home. 追问后续活动。
对比辨析
I wanted to went there.错误；应为I wanted to go there.。He didn't went.错误；应为He didn't go.。主句的过去时间不能让所有后续动词都机械地变过去式。

questions.prompt: We ___ (go) home and ___ (have) dinner yesterday.
questions.reference: went；had。两个并列主要动作均发生在过去。

questions.prompt: She wanted ___ (see) the film.
questions.reference: to see。wanted后保留to＋原形。

questions.prompt: 改错：They didn't played tennis.
questions.reference: They didn't play tennis. didn't后用原形。

questions.prompt: 把He took some pictures.改为一般疑问句。
questions.reference: Did he take any pictures? 一般询问通常用any；保留some在特定语境也可成立。

sections.title: 13 将来表达：计划与即将发生的事

blocks.text: 表达已经有的打算，先掌握be going to＋动词原形。will＋动词原形也能表达将来的事、预测或临时决定；本书先理解常见表达，不要求本周穷尽两者差别。
规则

rows: I am going to read tonight.
He isn't going to play football.
Are you going to visit the museum?
I will help you.；I won't be late.

blocks.text: 例句
We are going to take a trip next week. 我们打算下周去旅行。
What are you going to do tomorrow? 你明天打算做什么？
I think it will rain tomorrow. 我想明天会下雨。
I am going to the park. 我正要去／正前往公园。这里to后是地点。
容易混淆
I am going to read. 中read是动作；I am going to the park. 中the park是地点。先理解意思，再看结构。不要写 She going to reads.。

questions.prompt: She ___ going to ___ (visit) her aunt tomorrow.
questions.reference: is；visit。主语she用is，going to后用原形。

questions.prompt: 把 They are going to swim. 改成疑问句。
questions.reference: Are they going to swim? 把are移到主语前。

questions.prompt: I will ___ (help / helps) you.
questions.reference: help。will后用原形。

sections.title: 13.1 be going to与will：打算、预测、临时决定

blocks.text: 两种形式都能涉及将来，但常见使用情境不同。be going to常突出已有打算或依据眼前情况作出的判断；will常用于预测、临时决定、承诺或主动提出帮助。实际使用存在重叠。
规则详解
be going to要按主语选择am/is/are，后接动词原形。疑问和否定直接处理be。will不随人称改变，后接动词原形；否定will not常缩写为won't。
be going to do中的to后面是动作原形；be going to the park中的to后面是地点，going是go的-ing形式。看后面接什么，能避免误判。
看到tomorrow不必一律使用will。先判断是在陈述已有计划、作预测还是临时作决定。本节只掌握最常见的使用倾向。
例句与解析
1. I am going to visit my aunt this weekend. 已安排的探望计划。
2. Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain. 根据眼前迹象判断。
3. I think our team will win. 对将来结果的预测。
4. The phone is ringing. I will answer it. 当场决定去接电话。
5. I will help you with the bag. 主动提出帮助。
6. Are you going to read tonight? No, I am not. 对计划进行问答。
对比辨析
He will goes.错误；will后用go。She going to read.漏了is。I am going to the museum.里的museum是地点名词，不能因为出现going to就说后面必须另加动词。

questions.prompt: He will ___ (come / comes) tomorrow.
questions.reference: come。will后使用原形。

questions.prompt: 改为否定：They are going to swim.
questions.reference: They aren't going to swim.

questions.prompt: “电话响了，我来接。”用will写一句。
questions.reference: The phone is ringing. I will answer it. / I'll answer it.
accepted: The phone is ringing. I will answer it
The phone is ringing. I'll answer it

questions.prompt: 判断to后面的词：We are going to the library.
questions.reference: the library是地点名词短语；这里是go to某处。

sections.title: 14 把时间与句子结构连起来

blocks.text: 不要只凭一个“标志词”机械选时态。先判断说话者要表达习惯、眼前动作、过去经历还是计划，再检查主语和动词形式。
规则

rows: He is going to play tennis.
Is he going to play tennis?

blocks.text: 例句
I usually walk to school, but I took a bus yesterday. 我平时步行上学，但昨天坐了公交。
Mum is cooking now. She cooks dinner every evening. 妈妈现在正在做饭；每天晚上她都做饭。
I went to the library yesterday. I am going to go there again tomorrow. 昨天去了图书馆，明天还打算去。
容易混淆
同一段话可以有不同时间，只要意思清楚。today也不自动决定时态：I went shopping this morning. 若早晨已过去，就可使用过去时。

questions.prompt: He usually ___ (walk) to school.
questions.reference: walks。说日常习惯，主语he。

questions.prompt: Yesterday he ___ (take) a bus.
questions.reference: took。take的过去式为took。

questions.prompt: It is 7:30 now. He ___ (wait) for the bus.
questions.reference: is waiting。语境明确说此刻正在等车。

sections.title: 14.1 时态综合：先建立时间线，再检查动词

blocks.text: 一段话可以同时讲平时、昨天、现在和明天。每个句子都应对应它自己的时间。时态选择和动词搭配要同时检查。
规则详解
第一步看叙述角度：习惯／事实、正在发生、已经发生、将来计划。第二步找主语，检查第三人称单数或be的形式。第三步检查问句、否定句是否用了助动词。
时间词提供证据，但前后文也提供证据。例如What are you doing?后面的回答即使没有now，也通常延续正在发生的语境。
最后检查非谓语搭配：I wanted to buy…中wanted负责过去时间，to buy来自want的搭配。I enjoy reading.中的reading不使整句成为进行时。
例句与解析
1. I usually read after dinner. 我平时晚饭后读书。
2. Yesterday, I read a story about the sea. read在这里是过去式，读/red/。
3. Now I am drawing a picture for the story. 现在正在画。
4. Tomorrow, I am going to show it to my teacher. 明天的计划。
5. My sister wants to read the story too. wants表达当前愿望，to read为搭配。
6. Did you enjoy the story? Yes, I did. 过去问答用did，不给enjoy加-ed。
对比辨析
一句话里出现两个动词，不代表两个都按相同方式变化；两句话讨论同一个人，也不代表必须使用相同的时态。人物、时间、句型和搭配需要分别判断。

questions.prompt: He usually ___ (walk), but yesterday he ___ (take) a bus.
questions.reference: walks；took。前面习惯，后面过去。

questions.prompt: A: What are they doing? B: They ___ (make) a cake.
questions.reference: are making。回答沿用正在进行的语境。

questions.prompt: She wanted ___ (read) the book yesterday.
questions.reference: to read。过去时间由wanted表达。

questions.prompt: 把He went there yesterday.分别改成否定和疑问。
questions.reference: He didn't go there yesterday. / Did he go there yesterday? did后都用go。

sections.title: 15 there be：某处有什么

blocks.text: there be表示“某处存在某人或某物”；have表示某人或某物“拥有”。表达目的不同，不能直接混写。
规则

rows: 一个可数对象／不可数名词
There is a book on the desk.；There is some water.
There are two books on the desk.
Is there a park?；There aren't any shops here.
There was a small house here.；There were two trees.

blocks.text: 例句
There is a bike in the garden. 花园里有一辆自行车。
I have a bike. 我有一辆自行车。
How many students are there in your class? 你们班有多少学生？
There is a pen and two books on the desk. 常见教材表达中be与紧邻的名词一致。
容易混淆
不要写 There has a park. 或 There have two cats.。初学时列举多样物品也可拆句：There is a pen. There are two books.，更容易保证准确。

questions.prompt: There ___ some milk in the cup.
questions.reference: is。milk在这里不可数。

questions.prompt: There ___ three boys here yesterday.
questions.reference: were。过去的时间，three boys是复数。

questions.prompt: 改错：There have two chairs in my room.
questions.reference: There are two chairs in my room. there be表达某处有。
accepted: There are two chairs in my room

sections.title: 15.1 there be与have：存在、拥有及数量变化

blocks.text: there be把信息重点放在“某处有什么”；have把信息重点放在“谁或什么拥有”。两种结构能描述相关事实，但句子的主干不同。
规则详解
There is后常接单数可数名词或不可数名词；There are后接复数可数名词。过去对应There was/were。
否定可以用not any或no：There isn't any water. / There is no water.。一般疑问句移动be，回答Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.，不要把there换成it。
列举不同数量的名词时，常见教材表达使be与紧邻的名词一致。更清晰的写法也可以拆成两个句子。对数量提问用How many＋复数名词＋are there…?。
例句与解析
1. There is a library in our school. 我们学校里有图书馆。
2. Our school has a library. 我们学校拥有图书馆。
3. There are no shops near my home. 我家附近没有商店。
4. Is there any milk? Yes, there is. 问不可数名词的存在。
5. There was a tree here, but there are two now. 数量和时间同时变化。
6. There is a pen and two rulers on the desk. be跟紧邻的a pen匹配。
对比辨析
Is there a park?不回答Yes, it is.；应答Yes, there is.。It is a park.表示“它是公园”，是另一种句子。There have…不能替代普通there be结构。

questions.prompt: Is there a bank near here? 作否定回答。
questions.reference: No, there isn't. 与there be保持对应。

questions.prompt: 用there be改写：The town has two parks.
questions.reference: There are two parks in the town.
accepted: There are two parks in the town

questions.prompt: ___ there any water in the bottle?
questions.reference: Is。water不可数。

questions.prompt: 对数量提问：There are thirty students in the room.
questions.reference: How many students are there in the room?
accepted: How many students are there in the room

sections.title: 16 can、must、should与have to

blocks.text: 这些表达帮助我们说能力、允许、义务或建议。can、must、should后面接动词原形，不因he/she而给后面的动词加-s。have to的变化要单独注意。
规则

rows: You must stop.；You mustn't run here.
He has to get up early.
You don't have to come early.

blocks.text: 例句
Can I open the window? 我可以开窗吗？
She can play the piano. 她会弹钢琴。
Does he have to wear a uniform? 他必须穿制服吗？
You should see a doctor. 你应该去看医生。此处只是在学习建议句型。
容易混淆
mustn't是“不准”；don't have to是“不必”。两者意思不同。He can swims. 错误；He can swim. 正确。

questions.prompt: He can ___ (play / plays) chess.
questions.reference: play。can后用动词原形。

questions.prompt: “你不必今天完成。”选mustn't还是don't have to？
questions.reference: don't have to。句子没有禁止完成，只说不必今天完成。

questions.prompt: She ___ (have / has) to leave now.
questions.reference: has。she是第三人称单数；疑问句则为Does she have to…?。

sections.title: 16.1 must、have to、should：必须、不必与建议

blocks.text: 表达义务、禁止和建议时，否定形式尤其容易误解。先判断意思的强弱和是否允许，再选择结构。
规则详解
must表示较强的要求或必要性，mustn't表示禁止。have to也表示必须或需要，常强调实际情况带来的要求；两者在很多语境有重叠，不能绝对分成“主观”和“客观”。
have to随主语和时间变化：he has to，过去had to；否定和提问常用do/does/did。must、should后的普通动词使用原形。
don't have to表示不必，不等于禁止。should表示建议，强度通常低于must。回答Must I…?若说没有必要，可用No, you don't have to.，不用mustn't来表达“不必”。
例句与解析
1. You must wear a seat belt. 你必须系安全带。
2. You mustn't run on the wet floor. 不准在湿地板上跑。
3. He has to get up early for the train. 为赶火车，他必须早起。
4. He doesn't have to get up early tomorrow. 他明天不必早起。
5. You should check your answers. 你应该检查答案，是建议。
6. Did she have to leave early? 过去的提问由did承担，后用have。
对比辨析
You mustn't come early.表示不准早来；You don't have to come early.表示不用特意早来。两句都是否定，但对行动的要求不同。

questions.prompt: “不准拍照”填：You ___ take pictures here.
questions.reference: mustn't。表达禁止。

questions.prompt: “不必穿制服”填：You ___ wear a uniform.
questions.reference: don't have to。表达没有必要。

questions.prompt: He ___ (have) to work late yesterday.
questions.reference: had。过去的have to使用had to。

questions.prompt: 改错：She should drinks more water.
questions.reference: She should drink more water. should后用原形。

sections.title: 16.2 can、could与礼貌请求

blocks.text: can可以表达能力、允许或请求。could既可以表达过去的能力，也常用于更委婉的请求；出现could并不一定是在谈过去。
规则详解
can/could后接动词原形，不加to，也不因主语变化而加-s。否定形式can't/couldn't；一般疑问句将can/could移到主语前。
Can I…?通常请求允许自己做某事；Can you…?通常请求对方做某事。Could you…?常使请求更委婉。回应要看实际情境。
能力和许可要看上下文：Can you swim?通常问能力；Can I use your pen?通常请求允许。不要只把can固定译成“能够”。
例句与解析
1. She can speak English. 她会说英语，表达能力。
2. I could ride a bike when I was seven. 我七岁时会骑车，表达过去能力。
3. Can I open the window? 我可以开窗吗？请求允许。
4. Can you help me with this bag? 你能帮我拿这个包吗？请求帮助。
5. Could you say that again, please? 请你再说一遍好吗？委婉请求，不是在问过去。
6. Sorry, I can't. I am busy now. 抱歉，现在忙，婉拒当前请求。
对比辨析
She can to swim.和She can swims.都错误。礼貌请求Could you help me?的回答可以是Sure. /Of course.，不必机械地用过去形式回答Yes, I could.。

questions.prompt: 改错：He can speaks French.
questions.reference: He can speak French. can后用原形。

questions.prompt: 写一句礼貌请求：“请你关窗好吗？”
questions.reference: Could you close the window, please? / Can you close the window, please?
accepted: Could you close the window, please
Can you close the window, please

questions.prompt: I ___ (can / could) swim when I was eight.
questions.reference: could。when I was eight明确过去。

questions.prompt: Can I use your ruler? 作自然的允许回答。
questions.reference: Yes, you can. / Sure. / Of course. 均可。

sections.title: 17 祈使句与Let's：指令、请求、建议

blocks.text: 对听话的人发出指令、请求或建议时，常省略主语you，以动词原形开头。否定形式常用Don't＋动词原形。礼貌程度也取决于情境和语气。
规则

rows: Open the door, please. 请开门。
Don't run in the classroom. 不要在教室里跑。
Let's read together. 我们一起读吧。
Let's not be late. 我们别迟到。

blocks.text: 例句
Wash your hands before dinner. 饭前洗手。
Don't be afraid. 不要害怕。be仍然是动词原形。
Please sit down. 请坐。 / Let's play a game. 我们玩个游戏吧。
容易混淆
不能写 Don't running. 或 Let's to go.。应写 Don't run. 和 Let's go.。第16课的You mustn't run.也能表达禁止，但句子结构不同。

questions.prompt: 把 Open the window. 改为否定。
questions.reference: Don't open the window. Don't后接原形。

questions.prompt: Let's ___ (play / to play) football.
questions.reference: play。Let's后接动词原形。

questions.prompt: 连词成句：quiet / please / be
questions.reference: Please be quiet. / Be quiet, please. 两种语序都可以。

sections.title: 17.1 感叹句：what修饰名词组，how修饰性质

blocks.text: 感叹句突出惊讶、赞叹或其他强烈感受。先看强调的是一个名词组，还是形容词、副词表示的性质或程度。
规则详解
What＋a/an＋形容词＋单数可数名词＋主语＋谓语！如What a nice day it is!。名词若是复数或不可数，通常不用a/an：What beautiful flowers they are!。
How＋形容词或副词＋主语＋谓语！如How beautiful the flowers are!。主语和谓语在感叹句中通常仍保持陈述语序。
语境清楚时，what结构常省略后面的主语和谓语：What a great idea!。这类日常感叹是允许的省略，不应随意把所有名词短语都当成完整陈述句。
例句与解析
1. What a lovely cat it is! 多么可爱的猫！
2. What an interesting book this is! 多么有趣的书！
3. What beautiful flowers they are! 多么漂亮的花！
4. What nice weather it is! 天气真好！weather不可数。
5. How tall the tree is! 这棵树真高！how后直接接tall。
6. How fast he runs! 他跑得真快！fast修饰动作。
对比辨析
What nice weather!不能加a，因为weather在这里不可数。How beautiful the flowers are!不是How beautiful are the flowers!；后者更像疑问语序。

questions.prompt: ___ a beautiful picture it is!（What / How）
questions.reference: What。后接a beautiful picture这个名词组。

questions.prompt: ___ carefully she writes!（What / How）
questions.reference: How。carefully是副词。

questions.prompt: 改错：What a nice weather!
questions.reference: What nice weather! 去掉a。

questions.prompt: 改写：The dog is very cute. 用How开头。
questions.reference: How cute the dog is! 保持the dog is的陈述语序。

sections.title: 18 形容词与比较：更高、更大、更好

blocks.text: 形容词说明人或事物“怎么样”。它可以放在名词前，也可以在be等系动词后。比较两个对象时，常用“比较级＋than”。
规则

rows: 部分短词双写末尾辅音再加-er

blocks.text: 例句
She is a tall girl. / The girl is tall. 她是个高个子女孩。
This bag is bigger than that one. 这个包比那个大。
My ruler is longer than yours. 我的尺子比你的长。
He is the tallest boy in our class. 他是班里最高的男孩。此句先理解最高级含义。
容易混淆
不说 more taller；taller本身已经表示“更高”。比较的对象要合理：My bag is bigger than yours. 用yours代替your bag。

questions.prompt: 写比较级：heavy；big；good。
questions.reference: heavier；bigger；better。

questions.prompt: This room is ___ (small) than that one.
questions.reference: smaller。比较两个房间。

questions.prompt: 改错：He is more taller than me.
questions.reference: He is taller than me. / He is taller than I am. 去掉多余的more。
accepted: He is taller than I am

sections.title: 18.1 比较级：比较对象、程度与as…as

blocks.text: 比较句要同时说明比较的性质、比较的对象和比较的程度。比较双方应该具有可比较的同类信息，不能把人的书包与另一个人本身相比。
规则详解
常见结构：A＋be＋比较级＋than＋B。B可以用代词或物主代词替代，但要确保指代清楚。good/well的比较级常为better，bad为worse。
much、a lot可修饰比较级，表示差别较大；a little可表示差别较小。very通常不直接修饰taller这类比较级。more与-er比较级不要重复堆叠。
as＋形容词或副词原级＋as表示同等程度；not as…as表示不如。这里的形容词不变成比较级。
例句与解析
1. My bag is heavier than yours. 我的包比你的包重。yours代替your bag。
2. This room is much bigger than that one. 这间房大得多。
3. He is a little taller than me. 他比我高一点。
4. This film is more interesting than that one. 较长形容词使用more。
5. Anna is as tall as Lily. 安娜和莉莉一样高。
6. This road is not as wide as that one. 这条路没有那条宽。
对比辨析
My bag is heavier than you.通常把“包”与“人”作了不合适的比较，应改成than yours。more better、more taller都重复表示比较；very taller也不是常规搭配。

questions.prompt: 改错：This bike is very cheaper.
questions.reference: This bike is much cheaper. / This bike is cheaper. 可用much修饰比较级。

questions.prompt: My ruler is longer than ___ (your / yours).
questions.reference: yours。代替your ruler。

questions.prompt: She is as ___ (tall / taller) as her sister.
questions.reference: tall。as…as中用原级。

questions.prompt: 用a little表达“这本书比那本贵一点”。
questions.reference: This book is a little more expensive than that one.
accepted: This book is a little more expensive than that one

sections.title: 18.2 最高级：在一个范围里最突出

blocks.text: 比较级常比较两个对象的差别；最高级说明在给定范围里某个对象最突出。最高级必须有明确或可理解的比较范围。
规则详解
常见短形容词加-est；已有e加-st；辅音字母＋y变y为i再加-est；部分短词双写末尾辅音再加-est。较长形容词常用most。
常见特殊形式：good/better/best，bad/worse/worst，many或much/more/most。形容词最高级前通常有the，但已有my、his等限定词时，不再叠加the。
in常接范围、地点或群体，如in our class；of可接明确列出的同类对象，如of the three。one of the＋最高级＋复数名词表示“最……的之一”。
例句与解析
1. He is the tallest boy in our class. 他是班里最高的男孩。
2. This is the biggest room in the house. 这是房子里最大的房间。
3. It is the most interesting story of the three. 三个故事里最有趣的一个。
4. She is my best friend. 她是我最好的朋友。my前后不再加the。
5. This is one of the oldest buildings here. 这是这里最老的建筑之一。
6. Which is cheaper, A or B? Which is the cheapest of A, B and C? 两种范围对照。
对比辨析
one of the best students中students用复数，因为是在一组学生中取一个；如果整个one of…作主语，中心是one，通常用单数谓语。

questions.prompt: 写最高级：big；happy；good。
questions.reference: biggest；happiest；best。

questions.prompt: This is ___ (the / /) most useful book here.
questions.reference: the。普通形容词最高级前用the。

questions.prompt: 改错：She is the my best friend.
questions.reference: She is my best friend. my已经限定名词。

questions.prompt: He is one of the tallest ___ (boy / boys).
questions.reference: boys。one of后面的群体名词用复数。

sections.title: 19 副词：多常做，怎样做

blocks.text: 副词常补充动作怎样发生、发生得多频繁等信息。形容词通常说明人或物的特点；副词可以说明动作的方式。不要只看有没有-ly。
规则

rows: 形式与形容词相同的常见词

blocks.text: 例句
She usually walks to school. 频率副词常放在普通实义动词前。
She is usually early. 频率副词常放在be后。
He is a careful boy. He writes carefully. 他认真；他写字认真。
She is a good singer. She sings well. 她是好歌手，唱得好。
容易混淆
不是所有副词都加-ly：fast本身可以作副词。friendly虽然以-ly结尾，通常是形容词，表示“友好的”。先看词在句中的作用。

questions.prompt: 选词：She sings (good / well).
questions.reference: well。说明唱得怎样，用副词well。

questions.prompt: 调整位置：He late is never.
questions.reference: He is never late. never通常放在be后。

questions.prompt: 选词：Please read (careful / carefully).
questions.reference: carefully。说明阅读这个动作的方式。

sections.title: 19.1 频率、程度与方式：副词放哪里

blocks.text: 副词的位置和它修饰的内容有关。频率说多常发生，方式说怎样发生，程度说有多强。相近词形有时意思完全不同。
规则详解
always、usually、often、sometimes、never常放在普通实义动词前、be后。sometimes也常在句首或句末。表达频率还可用once a week、twice a month等。
very常修饰形容词或副词：very happy、very quickly。enough修饰形容词或副词时通常放后面：old enough；修饰名词时放前面：enough time。
hard可以作副词，表示努力地；hardly通常表示几乎不。good是形容词，well常作副词表示好；well表示身体好时也可作形容词。
例句与解析
1. She always finishes her homework. always在finishes前。
2. She is always careful. always在is后。
3. Sometimes we walk to school. sometimes可以在句首。
4. He works hard. 他努力工作。
5. He hardly works. 他几乎不工作，意思与上一句不同。
6. She is old enough to go alone. 她年龄足够大，可以独自去。
对比辨析
enough big应改成big enough；time enough在基础练习中优先用enough time。不能因为hardly长得像hard加-ly就当作“努力地”。

questions.prompt: 改错：He usually is late.（改为本课常用位置）
questions.reference: He is usually late. 频率副词常放在be后。

questions.prompt: 选词：She studies (hard / hardly), so she does well.
questions.reference: hard。后面说明表现好，前面表示努力学习。

questions.prompt: 填词序：We have ___ ___ .（time / enough）
questions.reference: enough time。enough修饰名词放前面。

questions.prompt: 改错：This bag is enough big.
questions.reference: This bag is big enough. enough修饰形容词放后面。

sections.title: 19.2 interesting与interested：引起感受和产生感受

blocks.text: 一些形容词成对出现：-ing形式常描述事物具有引起某种感受的特点，-ed形式常描述体验者的感受。不能简单背成“人只用-ed，物只用-ing”。
规则详解
interesting使人感兴趣，interested感兴趣；boring令人厌烦，bored感到无聊；exciting令人兴奋，excited感到兴奋；surprising令人惊讶，surprised感到惊讶。
一个人也可以具有让别人感兴趣的特点，所以He is interesting.可以正确；一个人感到兴趣，则可说He is interested in science.。
常见搭配也要一起记：be interested in、be excited about、be surprised at/by。这些词在be后描述状态，不要把所有-ed结尾词都当作过去时谓语。
例句与解析
1. The story is interesting. 故事有趣，能够引起读者兴趣。
2. I am interested in the story. 我对故事感兴趣。
3. The lesson was boring. 那节课令人觉得无聊。
4. The students were bored. 学生们感到无聊。
5. He is an interesting person. 他是个有趣的人，会让别人觉得有意思。
6. We were excited about the game. 我们对比赛感到兴奋。
对比辨析
I am boring.通常表示“我是个让别人觉得无聊的人”；I am bored.表示“我感到无聊”。只改一个结尾，主语与感受的关系就变了。

questions.prompt: This film is very ___ (interesting / interested).
questions.reference: interesting。描述电影引发兴趣的特点。

questions.prompt: I am ___ (boring / bored) because I have nothing to do.
questions.reference: bored。描述我的感受。

questions.prompt: She is interested ___ science.
questions.reference: in。固定搭配be interested in。

questions.prompt: 解释He is interesting.与He is interested.的区别。
questions.reference: 前者说他有趣，后者说他感兴趣；后者可接in…补充感兴趣的对象。

sections.title: 20 地点、方向与交通介词

blocks.text: 介词帮助说明物品之间的位置或动作的方向。学习时用图和动作建立联系，再把介词短语放进完整句子。
规则

rows: The ball is under the desk.
next to / in front of / behind
The library is next to the school.
The shop is between the bank and the park.
I walk to school with Lily.
by bus / by bike / on foot
He goes to school by bus.

blocks.text: 例句
I go to school by bus. = I take a bus to school. 两句都可表示乘公交上学。
Turn left at the bookstore. 在书店处左转。
Go home after school. 放学后回家。home在这个表达中不需要to。
容易混淆
go to school与go home要分别记；get to the park与get there也不同。表达交通方式时通常说by bus，不说by a bus；用take时可说take a bus。

questions.prompt: The bag is ___ (under / between) the chair.（在椅子下面）
questions.reference: under。between通常要说明在两个对象之间。

questions.prompt: I go to school ___ foot.
questions.reference: on。固定表达on foot。

questions.prompt: 改错：We go to home at five.
questions.reference: We go home at five. go home中不用to。

sections.title: 20.1 位置与方向：in、on、at、across和through

blocks.text: 位置介词描述静态关系，方向表达描述移动路线。同一个地点可以从不同角度描述，所以要结合说话者关注的范围判断。
规则详解
in强调在一个范围内部；on常强调接触表面；at常把地点看作一个点或活动场所。above和below通常不要求接触表面；over有在上方或越过的常见意思。
in front of表示在对象外部的前方；in the front of表示在对象内部的前部。between常用于明确对象之间；among常用于一个群体之中。
across常表示从表面或一边到另一边；through常表示穿过内部空间；along表示沿着。表达移动时，常与walk、go、run等动词搭配。
例句与解析
1. The keys are in the bag. 钥匙在包里。
2. The picture is on the wall. 画在墙面上。
3. We meet at the school gate. 我们在校门口这个点会合。
4. A tree is in front of the house. 树在房子外面的前方。
5. The teacher's desk is in the front of the classroom. 讲桌在教室内部前方。
6. Walk across the street, then go through the park. 横穿街道，再穿过公园内部。
对比辨析
on the wall常说挂在墙面上；in the wall常说嵌入墙体的物体，如a window in the wall。above表示在上方，不能自动等同于on所表达的接触关系。

questions.prompt: The cat is ___ the box.（在盒子内部）
questions.reference: in。表示内部。

questions.prompt: Walk ___ the bridge.（从桥的一端到另一端）
questions.reference: across。强调从一边到另一边经过桥面；over the bridge在常见语境也可表达过桥。

questions.prompt: There is a window ___ the wall.
questions.reference: in。窗户嵌在墙体中。

questions.prompt: 区别：in front of the bus与in the front of the bus。
questions.reference: 前者是公交车外面的前方；后者是公交车里面的前部。

sections.title: 21 时间介词：at、on、in与前后

blocks.text: 表示时间时，先判断说的是具体钟点、某一天，还是月份、季节、年份等较大的时间范围。再学习少量常见固定搭配。
规则

rows: 具体钟点；部分固定表达
星期、日期、某天的上午等
月份、季节、年份；一般上午等

blocks.text: 例句
We have English at nine on Monday. 我们周一九点上英语课。
I was born in June. 我出生在六月。
We play football after school. 我们放学后踢足球。
I am going to visit him next week. next week前通常不加in。
容易混淆
this morning、last week、next year、every day、yesterday等时间表达前，通常不再机械加at/on/in。at night与in the morning分别记。

questions.prompt: ___ Sunday；___ six thirty；___ July。
questions.reference: on；at；in。对应一天、钟点、月份。

questions.prompt: We will meet ___ Monday afternoon.
questions.reference: on。具体某一天的下午。

questions.prompt: 改错：I went there in last week.
questions.reference: I went there last week. last week前不用in。

sections.title: 21.1 时间点、时间段、多久以后与多久以前

blocks.text: 时间介词不仅区分at、on、in，还区分一个时间点、一段持续时间和相对现在的前后关系。看清时间短语在句子中的作用。
规则详解
at＋具体钟点；on＋具体一天或某天上午下午；in＋月份、季节、年份等。限定了某一天后，普通in the morning可能变成on Monday morning。
for＋一段时间常表示持续时长；during＋某个时期或活动，强调在那段期间；from…to…交代开始和结束。
在将来语境中，in＋一段时间常表示多久以后；一段时间＋ago表示多久以前。before/after可接时间或事件；today、tomorrow、last week等前面通常不再加at/on/in。
例句与解析
1. We meet at 8:30 on Friday morning. 钟点用at，具体周五早晨用on。
2. I stayed there for two hours. 我在那里待了两个小时。
3. We visited our grandparents during the holiday. 我们在假期期间探望祖父母。
4. The library is open from nine to five. 图书馆九点到五点开放。
5. He will return in three days. 他三天后回来。
6. He returned three days ago. 他三天前回来了。
对比辨析
for two hours说持续多久，in two hours在将来语境说从现在起多久以后。in也可在其他语境表示完成所需时间，如I finished it in two hours.，因此仍需结合完整句子。

questions.prompt: I was there ___ two hours yesterday.
questions.reference: for。表示持续时长。

questions.prompt: We will meet ___ two days.
questions.reference: in。将来语境中表示两天以后。

questions.prompt: He left two days ___.
questions.reference: ago。放在时间段后表示多久以前。

questions.prompt: We have a lesson ___ Tuesday afternoon.
questions.reference: on。具体某一天的下午。

sections.title: 22 数量、序数、日期和价格

blocks.text: 基数词说“几个”，序数词说“第几个”。数量词还要与可数、不可数的用法相配。先会日常表达，再补规则和拼写。
规则

rows: one → first；two → second；three → third；five → fifth；twenty→ twentieth
twenty-one → twenty-first；通常只变最后一个数词
many books；much water；a few apples；a little milk
两类都可以的常见表达
some books / some water；a lot of books / a lot of water

blocks.text: 例句
How many books do you have? 你有多少本书？
How much water do we need? 我们需要多少水？
How much is this bag? It is twenty yuan. 这个包多少钱？
My classroom is on the second floor. 我的教室在二楼。
容易混淆
a few表示“有一些”，修饰可数名词复数；a little修饰不可数名词。few/little不加a时常强调“很少，几乎没有”，先通过句子理解差别。

questions.prompt: 写序数词：three；twenty-one。
questions.reference: third；twenty-first。

questions.prompt: There is ___ (a few / a little) milk.
questions.reference: a little。milk在此不可数。

questions.prompt: ___ (How many / How much) are these shoes?
questions.reference: How much。这里问鞋子的价格。

sections.title: 22.1 数词：数量、序数、年龄、日期和钟点

blocks.text: 基数词表示几个，序数词表示第几个。日期、年龄和钟点还使用自己的常见表达方式，数字正确并不代表整个短语就正确。
规则详解
序数常见特殊拼写：first、second、third、fifth、eighth、ninth、twelfth；整十数常把-y变成-ieth，如twentieth。twenty-first等复合序数通常只改变最后部分。
明确数字后hundred、thousand通常不加-s：two hundred students。泛指许多时用hundreds of、thousands of。年龄表达I am eleven years old.；放在名词前可用an eleven-year-old boy。
钟点可直接读seven thirty，也可说half past seven；7:45可说a quarter to eight。日期书写如May 1st，读时可用May the first等常见形式。月份前in，具体日期前on。
例句与解析
1. There are two hundred students. 有两百名学生。hundred不加-s。
2. Hundreds of people came. 数百人来了。泛指数量用复数加of。
3. She is twelve years old. 她十二岁，years使用复数。
4. She is a twelve-year-old girl. 复合形容词中的year用单数。
5. My birthday is on June 12th. 我的生日在六月十二日。
6. It is a quarter past six. 六点一刻，即6:15。
对比辨析
twelve-year-old中的连字符把三个部分连为一个修饰语，year不加-s；I am twelve years old.中则有复数years。不要混成a twelve-years-old girl。

questions.prompt: 写序数词：nine；twelve；thirty。
questions.reference: ninth；twelfth；thirtieth。

questions.prompt: 改错：There are three hundreds books.
questions.reference: There are three hundred books. 确切数字后的hundred不加-s。

questions.prompt: 改错：He is a ten-years-old boy.
questions.reference: He is a ten-year-old boy. 复合形容词中year用单数。

questions.prompt: 用past或to表达7:45。
questions.reference: a quarter to eight。距离八点还差一刻。

sections.title: 22.2 many、much、few、little：数量与语气

blocks.text: 数量词要与名词的可数性相配，还可能表达“足够一些”或“几乎没有”的不同感觉。a在few/little前不是可有可无的装饰。
规则详解
many、a few、few接可数名词复数；much、a little、little接不可数名词。a lot of可用于两类名词。
a few/a little强调有一些；few/little常强调很少，接近没有，语气更偏不足。数量本身是否够用，还要结合上下文。
too many/too much表示太多；much too＋形容词或副词表示程度过高；enough＋名词表示足够的数量。some/any也要遵循其常见语境。
例句与解析
1. I have a few friends here. 我在这里有一些朋友。
2. I have few friends here. 我在这里朋友很少。
3. There is a little water left. 还剩一点水。
4. There is little water left. 剩水很少了，可能不够。
5. There are too many cars. 车太多，cars可数复数。
6. This bag is much too heavy. 这个包太重，much too修饰heavy。
对比辨析
too much homework表示作业太多；much too difficult表示难度太高。两者词序与后接内容不同。不能说many water或a few rice。

questions.prompt: There is ___ (a few / a little) juice.
questions.reference: a little。juice不可数。

questions.prompt: We have ___ (too many / too much) homework.
questions.reference: too much。homework不可数。

questions.prompt: The box is ___ (too much / much too) heavy.
questions.reference: much too。后接形容词heavy。

questions.prompt: 翻译差别：a few books / few books。
questions.reference: 前者强调有几本书，后者强调书很少。

sections.title: 23 动词搭配：to do、doing与原形

blocks.text: 两个动作放在一起时，后面的动词用什么形式，常由前面的词或结构决定。现阶段按常用搭配学习，不必一次学习完整的非谓语动词体系。
规则

rows: want / would like / plan ＋ to do
I want to read.；We plan to leave early.
I like swimming.；I like to swim in the morning.
Let me try.；Help me (to) carry it.

blocks.text: 例句
Would you like to join us? 你愿意加入我们吗？
How about going to the park? 去公园怎么样？
Thank you for helping me. 谢谢你帮助我。for是介词。
容易混淆
不要把like doing误记成“like后只能doing”；两种形式都有常见用法。to有时是介词，不能把所有to都当成to do的标记；遇到新搭配结合词典和课文学习。

questions.prompt: I want ___ (learn) English.
questions.reference: to learn。want to do。

questions.prompt: She enjoys ___ (dance).
questions.reference: dancing。enjoy doing，dance去e加-ing。

questions.prompt: He is good at ___ (swim).
questions.reference: swimming。at后接动词-ing，swim双写m。

sections.title: 23.1 to do：想做、计划做、要求某人做

blocks.text: to＋动词原形常作为一个动作单位，跟在某些动词后。先记完整结构，再改变句子的主语与主要动词时态。
规则详解
want、would like、plan、hope等常接to do。want to read、plan to visit里的后一个动词保持原形。主要动词可根据主语与时间变化，如wants、wanted、planned。
want/ask/tell sb to do把要做动作的人放在中间：ask him to help。否定常用ask/tell sb not to do。hope的常见基础结构是hope to do或hope＋句子，不机械套hope sb to do。
to do还可以表示目的：I went there to buy a book.意思是“为了买书”。判断它修饰什么，要结合句意。
例句与解析
1. I want to learn English. 我想学英语。
2. She wants to learn English. 主语变she，变化在wants。
3. She wanted to learn English last year. 过去变化在wanted。
4. The teacher asked us to read aloud. 老师让我们大声读。
5. Mum told me not to run on the stairs. 妈妈叫我别在楼梯上跑。
6. We went to the shop to buy some milk. to buy说明去商店的目的。
对比辨析
I want him to help me.中him是被希望去帮忙的人，用宾格。He wanted to helped me.错误：wanted负责过去时间，to后仍用help。

questions.prompt: She wants ___ (join) the club.
questions.reference: to join。want to do。

questions.prompt: The teacher told ___ (we) to sit down.
questions.reference: us。作told的宾语。

questions.prompt: 用tell写“老师让我们不要迟到”。
questions.reference: The teacher told us not to be late. not放在to be前。
accepted: The teacher told us not to be late
The teacher tells us not to be late

questions.prompt: 改错：He planned to went there.
questions.reference: He planned to go there. to后用原形。

sections.title: 23.2 doing：喜欢、完成、介词后与活动搭配

blocks.text: 动词-ing形式不只用于进行时。在一些动词、介词或活动搭配之后，它可以整体表示一个活动。需要同时看前面的词和整个句子的谓语。
规则详解
enjoy、finish、practice等常接doing；like/love可以有doing和to do两种常见结构，不要把其中一种误记为唯一形式。
介词后如果接动词形式，常用-ing：be good at drawing、thank you for helping、after finishing。部分结构里的to本身是介词，如look forward to，后面也可接-ing，作为衔接词组单独记。
go swimming、go shopping、go fishing是常见活动搭配。let sb do、help sb (to) do又采用不同形式，不能把所有“两个动词相连”都改成doing。
例句与解析
1. She enjoys reading stories. 她喜欢读故事。
2. I finished cleaning the room. 我完成了打扫房间。
3. He is good at drawing animals. 他擅长画动物。
4. Thank you for helping me. 谢谢你帮我。
5. We went swimming yesterday. went表示过去，swimming来自活动搭配。
6. Let me try. Help me carry the box. let与help后的形式要另记。
对比辨析
I like swimming.不是现在进行时，因为没有am/is/are＋动作-ing这一完整谓语结构。We are swimming.才表示正在游泳。动词形式必须连同它所在的结构一起判断。

questions.prompt: He enjoys ___ (cook).
questions.reference: cooking。enjoy doing。

questions.prompt: Thank you for ___ (come).
questions.reference: coming。for后用-ing，come去e。

questions.prompt: We went ___ (shop) last Sunday.
questions.reference: shopping。go shopping搭配，shop双写p。

questions.prompt: 改错：Let me to help you.
questions.reference: Let me help you. let sb do，不加to。

sections.title: 23.3 take、spend、pay与cost：时间和金钱的主语不同

blocks.text: 这四个动词都可能与花费有关，但常见句型不同。先确定谁作主语，再看后面接时间、金钱、物品还是动作。
规则详解
It takes/took sb＋时间＋to do说明做某事花某人多久；it作形式主语，真正讨论的是后面的动作。take的过去式是took。
人＋spend/spent＋时间或金钱＋on名词；或人＋spend/spent＋时间或金钱＋doing。人＋pay/paid＋金钱＋for物品。
物＋cost＋人＋金钱，或物＋cost＋金钱。一般现在时第三人称单数常为costs；常见过去式仍为cost。不要把人的主动付款和物品价格混成同一种句型。
例句与解析
1. It takes me twenty minutes to walk to school. 我步行上学花二十分钟。
2. I spend twenty minutes walking to school. 同一耗时，改用人作主语。
3. She spent fifty yuan on the book. 她在这本书上花了五十元。
4. She paid fifty yuan for the book. 她付了五十元买书。
5. The book cost her fifty yuan. 这本书花了她五十元。
6. How long does it take you to get there? 询问做这件事的耗时。
对比辨析
I spend two hours to read.在本课常见花费句型中应改为I spend two hours reading.。It takes me two hours reading.应改为It takes me two hours to read.。

questions.prompt: It took us an hour ___ (finish) the work.
questions.reference: to finish。It takes/took sb time to do。

questions.prompt: She spends an hour ___ (read) every day.
questions.reference: reading。spend time doing。

questions.prompt: I paid ten yuan ___ the pen.
questions.reference: for。pay money for something。

questions.prompt: 改错：I cost ten yuan for the pen yesterday.
questions.reference: I paid ten yuan for the pen yesterday. / The pen cost me ten yuan yesterday.
accepted: I paid ten yuan for the pen yesterday
The pen cost me ten yuan yesterday

sections.title: 23.4 say、speak、tell、talk与look、see、watch

blocks.text: 中文相近的词，在英语里可能要求不同的宾语或介词。把词义与搭配一起记，才能避免“每个单词都会却连不成句子”。
规则详解
say侧重说的内容，向某人说可用say…to sb；speak常用于语言或说话能力；tell常直接接人，可用于tell sb a story、tell sb to do；talk强调交谈，常配to/with/about。
look侧重主动看，接对象常用look at；see侧重看见；watch常指关注有变化的活动、节目等。listen侧重主动听，接对象常用listen to；hear侧重听到。
read常用于文字、书报等。固定搭配有自己的习惯，如watch TV、see a film/watch a film、read a book。不能依据同一个中文“看”一律选同一动词。
例句与解析
1. She can speak English. 她会说英语，语言前常用speak。
2. Please tell me your name. 请告诉我名字，tell直接接me。
3. He said hello to me. 他向我问好，said后是说的内容。
4. We talked about the film. 我们谈论那部电影，about引出话题。
5. Look at the sky. Can you see the bird? 主动看天空，是否看见鸟。
6. Listen carefully. Can you hear the music? 主动听，是否听见音乐。
对比辨析
Look the picture.和listen music.都漏介词，应说look at the picture、listen to music。tell to me your name.不符合本课常见tell sb sth结构，改为tell me your name。

questions.prompt: She can ___ (say / speak) Chinese.
questions.reference: speak。语言常与speak搭配。

questions.prompt: Please ___ (tell / talk) me a story.
questions.reference: tell。tell sb a story。

questions.prompt: Look ___ the blackboard.
questions.reference: at。look at某物。

questions.prompt: I am listening ___ the radio.
questions.reference: to。listen to某物。

sections.title: 24 把句子连起来：原因、转折与细节

blocks.text: 先把每个简单句说准确，再用连接词表达它们之间的关系。读长句时，可以先找每一部分的主语和动词，再看连接词把它们怎样联系起来。
规则

rows: I like tea and milk.；It is small, but it is nice.
Do you want tea or milk?
I like English because it is useful.
It was raining, so we stayed home.
Call me when you get home.；If it rains, we will stay home.

blocks.text: 例句
I stayed home because I was tired. 因为累，我待在家。
I was tired, so I stayed home. 我累了，所以待在家。
What a beautiful day! / How beautiful the flowers are! 感叹句先理解赞叹的意思；详细规则随教材学习。
容易混淆
本阶段标准练习中，表达同一组因果关系通常选择because或so组织，不写 Because I was tired, so I stayed home.。when/if的系统规则可以留到后续，不必本周全部展开。

questions.prompt: 选词：I like pandas ___ (because / but) they are cute.
questions.reference: because。后半句给出喜欢的原因。

questions.prompt: 选词：It is small, ___ (but / because) it is useful.
questions.reference: but。表达虽小但有用的转折。

questions.prompt: 把两句用so连接：It was cold. We stayed inside.
questions.reference: It was cold, so we stayed inside. 前因后果。
accepted: It was cold, so we stayed inside

sections.title: 24.1 连接词与复合句：关系先清楚，结构再展开

blocks.text: 连词可以连接词、短语，也可以连接句子。判断句子之间是并列、选择、转折、原因、结果、时间还是条件，有助于理解长句。
规则详解
and连接并列信息，but表达转折，or表达选择。because引出原因；so引出结果。表达同一组因果关系时，本阶段规范练习通常不把because和so同时作为这组关系的两端。
when引出时间关系；if引出条件。讨论将来的条件或时间时，常见结构是主句用will，从句用一般现在时：If it rains, we will stay home.。这是衔接规则，不等于所有if/when句子都必须用将来时。
从句放前面时，常用逗号与主句分开；放后面时常不需要逗号。阅读时先划出连接词两侧的主语和动词，就能看出两个部分的关系。
例句与解析
1. I like tea, but my brother likes milk. 同一主题上的转折。
2. You can read a book or draw a picture. 给出两个选择。
3. I stayed home because I was tired. 后半部分解释原因。
4. I was tired, so I stayed home. 前半部分原因，后半部分结果。
5. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home. 明天下雨是待在家的条件。
6. I will call you when I get home. 我到家时给你打电话。
对比辨析
If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.在这里的常见将来条件句里应改为If it rains tomorrow…。但是I don't know if he will come.中的if表示“是否”，属于另一种后续学习结构，不能把规则无限套用。

questions.prompt: 用because连接：I like the book. It is useful.
questions.reference: I like the book because it is useful.
accepted: I like the book because it is useful

questions.prompt: 用so连接：It was cold. We closed the window.
questions.reference: It was cold, so we closed the window.
accepted: It was cold, so we closed the window

questions.prompt: If he ___ (come) tomorrow, we will tell him.
questions.reference: comes。这里是将来条件从句，常用一般现在时。

questions.prompt: 改错：Because I was busy, so I didn't go.
questions.reference: Because I was busy, I didn't go. / I was busy, so I didn't go.
accepted: Because I was busy, I didn't go
I was busy, so I didn't go

sections.title: 词组详表①：日常与学校活动

rows: I woke up at six today.
He brushes his teeth twice a day.
I wash my face every morning.
He took a shower after the game.
We are getting ready for the test.
We do grammar exercises every day.
She keeps a diary in English.
We must be on time for class.
He was absent from school yesterday.

blocks.text: one's要随主语变化：I brush my teeth；he brushes his teeth。do exercises常指做练习；do exercise也可表示进行锻炼，注意语境。

sections.title: 词组详表②：学习方法与动作指令

rows: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
We can learn from each other.
I tidy up my room on Sundays.
Can you turn on the light?
Put on your coat. It is cold.
He took off his wet shoes.
Can I try on this jacket?

blocks.text: 可分开的动词短语遇到代词作宾语时，常把代词放中间：turn it off、put them away、pick it up。不要写turn off it。

sections.title: 词组详表③：位置、路线和交通

rows: We got on the bus at the station.
Get off at the next stop.
She got out of the taxi.
Look carefully before you cross the street.
I met him on the way to school.
We arrived at the station at nine.
They left for Shanghai this morning.
The bank is across from the park.
He sat in the front of the bus.
The shop is between the bank and the school.
The library is at the end of the road.
My house is next to a small park.

blocks.text: arrive、get、reach的搭配不同：arrive at the station、get to the station、reach the station。here、there、home前常不用对应的to：get home、arrive there。

sections.title: 词组详表④：购物、饮食与数量

rows: Let's look at the menu first.
Are you ready to order food?

sections.title: 词组详表⑤：交往、帮助与交流

rows: I am going to meet my friends.
I want to make friends with her.
She writes to her cousin every month.
I got a letter from my friend.
We invited him to the party.

He helps me with my English.

I borrowed a pen from Lily.
Lily lent a pen to me.
Please say hello to your parents.
She looks after her little sister.
We should be kind to animals.

blocks.text: borrow表示从别人那里借入，lend表示把自己的东西借出：I borrowed a book from him. = He lent a book to me. 两句事件相同，观察角度不同。

sections.title: 词组详表⑥：活动、感受和动作结构

rows: We went for a walk after dinner.
They are going hiking this weekend.
We had a picnic by the lake.
She fed the animals on the farm.
We need to get enough sleep.
We are excited about the trip.
I plan to visit the museum.
I hope to see you soon.
We need to clean the room.

blocks.text: stay healthy中的healthy说明状态；feel better中的better表示感觉更好。plan、decide、hope后常接to do；finish后接doing，分别记结构。

rows: The leaf fell to the ground.

sections.title: 词组库①：把词组变成自己的句子

blocks.text: 先遮住右栏，根据左栏造句，再和例句比较。每天选择10-15个确实不熟悉的词组。已熟练的内容，用换人物、换时间的方式复习。

rows: I get up at seven. 我七点起床。
She has breakfast at home. 她在家吃早饭。
He goes to school on foot. 他步行上学。
I do my homework after dinner. 我晚饭后做作业。
They go home at five. 他们五点回家。
go to bed 上床睡觉
I went to bed early yesterday. 我昨天很早就睡了。
She is listening to music. 她正在听音乐。
I like reading books. 我喜欢读书。
We played basketball last Sunday. 我们上周日打了篮球。
He can play the piano. 他会弹钢琴。
I don't watch TV before school. 我上学前不看电视。
I help with the housework. 我帮忙做家务。

blocks.text: 三次变换
以go to school为例：I go to school by bus. → He goes to school by bus. → Did he go to school by bus yesterday?
请另选两个词组，各说一个关于自己的句子，再改成“他／她”和“昨天”。写在练习本上。

sections.title: 词组库②：位置、计划、经历和搭配

rows: She is good at drawing. 她擅长画画。
be interested in 对……感兴趣
I am interested in science. 我对科学感兴趣。
My bag is different from yours. 我的包和你的不同。
He is afraid of dogs. 他怕狗。
Don't be late for school. 上学不要迟到。
I am looking for my key. 我正在找钥匙。

They went swimming yesterday. 他们昨天去游泳了。
We are going to take a trip. 我们打算去旅行。
have a good time 玩得开心
We had a good time. 我们玩得很开心。
would like to do 想／愿意做
