blocks.text: 特别记住
带be的词组，be也要随人物和时间变化：I am good at drawing. / She is good at drawing. /He was afraid of dogs. 不要只背good at而忘记完整结构。
词组不是越多越好。每个词组能独立说一句、换一次人物或时间，比只看中英文对照更有用。

writing.label: 我的造句与复述
writing.prompt: 选出本页不熟悉的词组，写成自己的句子，或按原文提示完成复述。

sections.title: 动词变化速查：把同一个动词认出来

blocks.text: 先记课文中用到的高频词。过去式不是全部加-ed，动词-ing也不是全部直接加-ing。read的现在式和过去式拼写相同，读音不同。
be的现在形式还包括am和are，具体搭配见第02课。read原形读/riːd/，过去式读/red/；请结合教材音频分辨。

sections.title: 读一篇短文，看语法怎样合作

blocks.text: 先读故事

My name is Leo. I am eleven and I live near a small park. On school days, I get up at seven. My sister gets up ten minutes earlier. We usually walk to school together. She likes drawing, but I enjoy reading stories. There is a library next to our school. We go there on Fridays. Today is Saturday. It is raining, so we are at home. My sister is drawing a cat, and I am reading a book about animals. Our parents are making lunch. After lunch, we are going to play a board game together.
先找信息，再分析结构
读句子的示范
My sister gets up ten minutes earlier. → 谁：My sister；做什么：gets up；补充：ten minutes earlier。gets说明主语是第三人称单数；earlier说明更早。
It is raining, so we are at home. → 前面说原因，so后说结果。is raining表示正在下雨；are at home表示现在的位置。
把Leo的名字换成自己，修改至少三条真实信息，口头重述。不会的词可以查，但先尝试从上下文判断意思。

questions.prompt: How old is Leo?
questions.reference: He is eleven. 第一、二句提供信息。

questions.prompt: What time does his sister get up?
questions.reference: At 6:50 / ten to seven. 她比七点早十分钟起床。

questions.prompt: How do they usually go to school?
questions.reference: They usually walk to school / go to school on foot. 注意问的是通常方式。
accepted: They go to school on foot
They usually go to school on foot

questions.prompt: Why are they at home today?
questions.reference: Because it is raining. 原文用so连接下雨和待在家。

questions.prompt: What are their parents doing?
questions.reference: They are making lunch. 是此刻进行中的动作。

questions.prompt: 找出一句习惯、一个正在进行的动作、一个计划。
questions.reference: 习惯如We usually walk to school together.；当前动作如My sister is drawing a cat.；计划是we are going to play a board game together。

writing.label: 我的造句与复述
writing.prompt: 选出本页不熟悉的词组，写成自己的句子，或按原文提示完成复述。

sections.title: 读懂过去经历，不被单个词带偏

blocks.text: 先读故事

Last Sunday, Anna and her father went to a farm by bus. They arrived at nine. The farm was smaller than Anna's school, but there were many animals. Anna fed the chickens and took some pictures. Her father helped a farmer carry vegetables. At noon, they had lunch under a big tree. Anna wanted to ride a horse, but it started to rain. They did not ride that day. They went home at three. Anna was tired, but she was happy. She wrote about the trip in her diary. Next month, she is going to visit the farm again.
阅读任务
可先理解的词
arrived到达；fed是feed（喂）的过去式；carry搬、提；vegetables蔬菜；diary日记。

This Saturday, I am going to visit a museum with my father. We are going to get there by bus. I want to learn about old trains. After the visit, we are going to have lunch near the museum. I am going to take a notebook because I want to write down interesting things.

blocks.text: A Museum Visit

Ben usually spends Saturday mornings at home. Last Saturday, he went to a science museum with his cousin, Lucy. They took a bus because the museum was far from home. They arrived at ten and stayed for two hours. Ben liked the old trains best. Lucy enjoyed a show about the moon. They did not buy any gifts, but they took some pictures where it was allowed. Now Ben is writing about the visit. Next Saturday, he is going to show his pictures to his classmates.
口语：任选一个真实主题，连续说6句左右
A. 介绍自己与一天的生活。 B. 讲一个真实的过去周末。 C. 说明下周末的计划。可以停顿，但尽量不用背过的整篇范文。
写作：My Last Weekend
写50-80词，包含：① 时间；② 地点与同伴；③ 至少两项活动；④ 感受或原因。若没有外出，写在家的真实经历也很好。先独立写，再按复习卡修改。
写作没有唯一答案。书后给出参考范例与检查方法，不能把与范例不同的真实表达都判为错误。

01 句子有骨架：谁，怎么样，做什么
1. 主语My father；动词cooks；dinner是动作涉及的对象。
2. We like English. 主语在前，谓语动词随后。
3. is。这里用be连接主语和形容词clean。
01.1 词类：同一个词在句子里做什么
1. 动词。这里要求听话的人打扫桌子。
2. 形容词。这里描述桌子的状态。
3. well。它修饰speaks，表示说得怎样。
4. under。后面接the chair，表示位置关系。
01.2 句子成分：主语、谓语、宾语与表语
1. The boy near the window。near the window修饰boy，属于整个主语短语。
2. dinner。它是cooks这个动作涉及的对象。
3. beautiful。它在are后描述flowers。
4. yesterday。它说明动作发生的时间。
01.3 五种基本句型：把句子的主干补完整
1. is / tastes都可构成合理句子。is作最基础答案；tastes是“尝起来”。
2. Give the ruler to me. 给出的物品在前，接受者放在to后。
3. He bought me a gift. buy可用“人＋物”的双宾语结构。
4. 宾语补足语。它说明the cat的名字。
01.4 英语语序：修饰词、时间和地点怎样摆
1. She has a red bike. 主语＋动词＋宾语，red修饰bike。
2. He is usually early. usually常在be之后。
3. I like reading very much. / I really like reading.
4. The book on the desk is mine. 介词短语放在book之后。
02 be、have、do：三个常用动词
1. are。parents是复数。
2. has。Tom是第三人称单数。
3. 第一个Do是助动词，帮助提问；第二个do是实义动词，表示“做”。
02.1 be的用法：身份、状态、位置和动作组合
1. was；is。前半句是昨天，后半句是今天。
2. Is she in the library? 移动is，位置短语不变。

1. boxes；babies；children。
2. glasses。glass表示杯子时可数，two后用复数。
3. Lily's schoolbag / Lily's bag。人名后加's表示所属。

1. cities；boys；leaves；photos。分别对应不同规则或常用特殊变化。
2. women；teeth；sheep。
